with the AI: over one thousand snares in the first month of field tests
costs and harms: Editor's note: The model learned from historical patrol detections, which can only label places and periods that patrols observed. The retained record also requires poacher behavior to remain spatially predictable.

benefit: EyeBOX missed its goals for accuracy but helped rule out concussion
AI system or service: EyeBOX
deployed by: Oculogica (clinical study in 282 patients with head injury)
measured against: Pre-specified goals for the lower confidence limits of sensitivity and specificity
with the AI: Sensitivity 80.4% and specificity 66.1%, with neither goal met
costs and harms: EyeBOX missed 9 of the 46 patients with concussion, a false negative rate of 19.6 percent, and it flagged 80 of the 236 patients without concussion as positive, so only 156 of them were correctly cleared.

benefit: Speech recognizer drafts transcripts of speeches in Iceland's parliament
vendor: Reykjavik University Language and Voice Lab (ASR for Althingi project)
AI system or service: Althingi ASR system (time-delay deep neural network acoustic model, n-gram language model, punctuation and paragraph models)
deployed by: Alþingi (Icelandic parliament) speech department
measured against: the previous manual first-stage transcription by Althingi's transcribers
without the AI: First, a human transcriber listens to the audio and transcribes the speech.
with the AI: the speech transcripts are now available sooner than before
costs and harms: Editors still corrected the drafts. The team kept rescoring with n-grams, because rescoring with a recurrent neural network used more memory and time and did not improve the sampled speeches from production.

benefit: People with severe paralysis regained control of a computer at home
vendor: Synchron Inc. with the University of Melbourne
AI system or service: Synchron Stentrode with a participant-specific decoder and Tobii Dynavox eye tracking
deployed by: Royal Melbourne Hospital (implantation and follow-up); participants' homes (use)
measured against: An earlier, separate study of the Utrecht implanted interface
without the AI: Home use began 197 days after implantation in that earlier participant
with the AI: Home use began on days 86 and 71 in the two Stentrode participants
costs and harms: Implantation required anesthesia and antiplatelet treatment. One participant fainted briefly after surgery. The later four-person report recorded eight mild device effects.

benefit: SkinVision flags a changing mole that proves to be a stage 1A melanoma
AI system or service: SkinVision skin-check app (AI analysis of smartphone photographs of moles, graded low, medium or high risk)
deployed by: not in the sources
measured against: his own expectation of what he would have done without the app
without the AI: a changing mole that he had not shown to a doctor for 12 months
with the AI: a stage 1A melanoma removed, with no spread found
costs and harms: The Basel and Zurich researchers found that the app rated far more lesions high risk than dermatologists did. The BMJ review authors warned that such apps cannot be relied on to detect all skin cancers.

benefit: Blackpool uses AI road imagery to fill 5,145 potholes for about £450,000
AI system or service: Project Amber road-condition imagery and AI survey (Blackpool Council)
deployed by: Blackpool Council
measured against: the council's pothole compensation payouts in the years before Project Amber
costs and harms: Editor's note: The likely mechanism is that identifying damage sooner allowed cheaper treatment before deterioration. The program-level figures do not isolate the software's contribution.

benefit: Software detects necrosis in meningioma images in university research
vendor: International Institute of Information Technology Bangalore (IIIT Bangalore)
AI system or service: IIIT Bangalore necrosis-detection pipeline
deployed by: not in the sources
measured against: not in the sources
costs and harms: Editor's note: The source limits the task to one pathology feature and explicitly calls for larger, diverse validation.

benefit: Datamining score finds more payment errors in French family benefits
AI system or service: Data-mining risk score of the family branch of French social security (le datamining)
deployed by: Caisses d'allocations familiales (Caf), nationwide
measured against: Desk checks picked by the score in 2012, its first year of use
with the AI: 26 % de dossiers comportant des indus et 22 % des rappels détectés en 2019
costs and harms: The Cour notes that the model uses the beneficiary's nationality, in three categories, and the postcode where they live, with local population traits. The Défenseur des droits notes that a high score makes a check much more likely, so those people are checked more often, and that checks weigh more heavily on the most precarious people.

benefit: Pounce texts help Georgia State students file for financial aid
AI system or service: Pounce, Georgia State University's AI text-message chatbot built by Mainstay
deployed by: Georgia State University (Atlanta campus and Perimeter College), through its National Institute for Student Success
measured against: Students who received only the usual university communication
without the AI: About 59 percent filed the FAFSA by the end of spring (GSU-Atlanta control group)
with the AI: About three percentage points more likely to file
costs and harms: About 5 percent of the first group of students at the Atlanta campus stopped the messages altogether and another 8 percent paused them. The chatbot sent questions it could not answer to university staff, who wrote the replies.

benefit: Mobileye-630 warnings fall by 30 to 70% for 21 private drivers
AI system or service: Mobileye-630 aftermarket collision avoidance system
deployed by: Insurance Institute for Highway Safety study (units installed in 21 privately owned vehicles)
measured against: The same drivers' 4-week baseline period
with the AI: Warning rates 30 to 70% lower in the 8-week treatment period
costs and harms: Many drivers said that they preferred less conservative warning thresholds.

benefit: Danish tax staff find misuse in about half the firms that a model flags
AI system or service: Scoring model based on machine learning (scoringsmodel baseret på machine learning) for reversals of withheld income tax (A-skat) in eIndkomst
deployed by: Skattestyrelsen (Danish Tax Agency)
measured against: not in the sources
costs and harms: By the preliminary count, misuse or fraud was found in only about half of the checked companies that the model rated most risky. The agency also says that most reversals are error corrections and ordinary adjustments, not fraud.

benefit: Audit court cites AI batching as a possible reason for Carf's output
AI system or service: Artificial intelligence for forming batches of appeals for repetitive judgment (inteligência artificial para formação de lotes de processos para julgamentos repetitivos), not named in the audit
deployed by: Conselho Administrativo de Recursos Fiscais (Carf), Ministry of Economy, through its ordinary and extraordinary panels
measured against: Decisions by Carf's ordinary and extraordinary panels in 2017
costs and harms: Reported hours of the panels rose 35.73%, from 220,420 in 2017 to 299,185 in 2019, while the backlog fell only 1.06%. The auditors say that the extra decisions are not final, because they can still go to special appeal.

benefit: WFP says that it used ALIA data in its analysis after Typhoon Kammuri
vendor: WFP Philippines, with support from the WFP Innovation Accelerator
AI system or service: ALIA (Automated Livelihoods Information Assistant)
deployed by: WFP Philippines, for anticipatory action and post-disaster vulnerability analysis
measured against: not in the sources
costs and harms: not in the sources

benefit: An early warning helps Amsterdam anesthetists keep blood pressure up
AI system or service: Hypotension Prediction Index (HPI)
deployed by: Amsterdam UMC, location AMC
measured against: Standard care with the same blood pressure goal
without the AI: 32.7 minutes median time in hypotension per patient
with the AI: 8.0 minutes median time in hypotension per patient
costs and harms: FDA names a primary risk of fluid overload or vasopressor treatment that follows a false positive reading when an anesthesiologist relies on that reading alone. In an observational study of 100 patients, the default index alarm had a positive predictive value of 31.9%.

benefit: Shield+ alerts cut conflict warnings on campus buses in Gainesville
AI system or service: Mobileye Shield+
deployed by: Gainesville Regional Transit System, in a University of Florida testbed funded by the Florida Department of Transportation
measured against: The same buses in stealth mode, when warnings were recorded without alerting drivers
with the AI: Pedestrian collision warnings down 38.6% across all open-mode data and 33.4% for similar dates
costs and harms: The system cost about $8,900 to install and $240 a year. For 28 Florida transit agencies, the report's cost tool found a positive net benefit in only nine communities. Drivers reported too many alerts, alerts for no apparent reason, alerts for stationary objects and missed pedestrian alerts, and they often met the system without training.

benefit: Apple Watch heart-rate alarms lead doctors to find atrial fibrillation
AI system or service: Apple Watch heart-rate notifications, Irregular Rhythm Notification and ECG app
deployed by: not in the sources
measured against: the standard rhythm workup after her transient ischemic attack two months earlier
without the AI: Sinus rhythm at the stroke team review and throughout a 24-hour outpatient ECG, with no atrial fibrillation diagnosis and treatment with clopidogrel
with the AI: Atrial fibrillation with a fast ventricular response on ECG after the watch alarms, followed by rate control and a direct oral anticoagulant
costs and harms: The Mayo Clinic authors warn that false positives may lead to overuse of care. In their study, only 11.4% of 264 patients seen after an abnormal pulse on an Apple Watch received an actionable cardiovascular diagnosis.

benefit: Brain implant decodes a paralyzed man's attempted speech into sentences
AI system or service: UCSF speech neuroprosthesis (BRAVO trial)
deployed by: University of California, San Francisco
measured against: the typing interface that he usually controlled with his head
without the AI: about 5 correct words or 18 correct characters per minute by typing
with the AI: a median 15.2 decoded words per minute with a median word error rate of 25.6%, from a 50-word vocabulary
costs and harms: The system depended on an implanted subdural array with a connector. Clinical and regulatory guidelines on the connector kept him from using the system on his own. Decoded sentences had a median word error rate of 25.6%.

benefit: Spotlight may have led to a missing child's recovery in weeks
vendor: Thorn (with Amazon Rekognition for face matching)
AI system or service: Spotlight (Thorn), using Amazon Rekognition
deployed by: An unnamed California law enforcement officer and agency
measured against: not in the sources
costs and harms: Spotlight matches faces with Amazon's facial recognition. WIRED notes accusations that police use of that technology endangers privacy and that the technology is inaccurate. The sources report no cost or harm from this recovery itself.

benefit: Medicare contractors cover Envisia to spare patients lung surgery
AI system or service: Envisia Genomic Classifier
deployed by: Pulmonologists who order the test for Medicare patients with suspected idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis in the four contractors' jurisdictions
measured against: Diagnoses that expert multidisciplinary teams made from histopathology for the same patients
with the AI: a 92% categorical agreement in IPF vs non-IPF diagnosis (interim results, n=56)
costs and harms: In the blinded test set, sensitivity was 70% and specificity 88%, so the classifier missed some patients with the usual pattern and wrongly flagged others. The test needs transbronchial biopsy samples. The coverage text puts pneumothorax at 0.7% to 2% and significant bleeding at 1% to 4% for that biopsy.

benefit: Mercado Libre credit score predicted defaults better than the bureau
AI system or service: Mercado Libre internal credit rating (machine-learning credit score) for Mercado Crédito
deployed by: Mercado Libre (Mercado Crédito), lending to merchants in Argentina
measured against: Logistic models with the local credit bureau score, alone or with borrower characteristics
without the AI: AUROC 0.64 (bureau score) and 0.68 (bureau score with borrower characteristics)
costs and harms: The authors say that the early evidence raises questions about the impact of BigTech lenders on financial stability and overall economic welfare.

benefit: FluChip-8G read by neural networks matched a cleared influenza test
AI system or service: FluChip-8G Influenza A+B Assay
deployed by: InDevR (clinical study at three US testing sites on archived surveillance swabs)
measured against: An FDA-cleared influenza molecular assay on the same specimens
with the AI: Sensitivity 87.9% and specificity 98.8% for influenza A, 100.0% and 99.8% for influenza B
costs and harms: The assay detected 51 of 58 influenza A positives and correctly cleared 915 of 926 negatives. It detected all 22 influenza B positives and cleared 960 of 962 negatives. Of 1058 specimens, 62 (5.9%) gave invalid results, 36 of them after a user error.

benefit: Caption Guidance let nurses take usable heart scans
vendor: Caption Health, Inc. (listed as Bay Labs, Inc. in the FDA database)
AI system or service: Caption Guidance
deployed by: Northwestern Memorial Hospital and Minneapolis Heart Institute
measured against: Unguided scans of the same patients by trained sonographers
with the AI: Agreement in qualitative visual assessment of 92.5% to 99.6% for primary parameters
costs and harms: The nurses' exams with Caption Guidance fell short of diagnostic quality for right ventricular size in 18 of 240 patients and for left ventricular size, function and effusion in 3 of 240. FDA lists device error that fails to guide the user to diagnostic-quality images as a risk that could delay or prolong examinations or lead to unnecessary procedures.

benefit: Traveler Verification Service met its accuracy goals at airport exits
vendor: U.S. Customs and Border Protection (GAO does not name the algorithm's supplier)
AI system or service: Traveler Verification Service (TVS), facial recognition for biometric air exit
deployed by: U.S. Customs and Border Protection with airline and airport partners
measured against: The minimum accuracy requirements in CBP's Operational Requirements Document
without the AI: At least 90 percent correct matches and at most 0.1 percent false matches
with the AI: 98 percent correct matches and 0.0092 percent false matches
costs and harms: As of May 2020, CBP had audited only one of more than 20 airline partners for privacy compliance. On one flight GAO observed, the system could not match about 25% of travelers because of camera and lighting problems. After a 2019 data breach, CBP increased audits of contractors. Airline agents skipped photos of some families and wheelchair users.

benefit: Risicomodel van teruggave btw doubles the hit rate of VAT checks
AI system or service: Risicomodel van teruggave btw (the Belastingdienst's risk model for VAT refund returns)
deployed by: Belastingdienst, for the selection of VAT refund returns for checks by tax inspectors
measured against: The old selection rules for VAT refund returns, which the model replaced
without the AI: De trefkans van het oude model voor btw-teruggave was 17%
with the AI: met het nieuwe model wordt een trefkans van 34% gehaald
costs and harms: The Netherlands Court of Audit found that the Belastingdienst's risk models select only returns suspected of declaring too little tax, so taxpayers who overstate what they owe are not picked out. During the audit, staff of the data unit could still email files outside the Belastingdienst. This was then blocked.

benefit: Forest sensors alert West Sumatra patrols to chainsaws
AI system or service: Rainforest Connection Guardian bioacoustic monitoring with cloud AI sound classification and app alerts
deployed by: Community forest patrols and the West Sumatra forestry department (Solok regency, Indonesia); RFCx partners in other countries
measured against: logging in the Sirukam forest before the sensors and the crackdown
without the AI: about 200 of Sirukam's 6,000 residents worked in illegal logging
with the AI: a patroller says that logging has totally stopped
costs and harms: Warsi said that not all of the 12 chainsaw alerts that it counted were illegal. No other cost or harm has been reported.

benefit: Collision Avoidance Assist and Lane Assist earn the Model 3 94%
AI system or service: Collision Avoidance Assist (autonomous emergency braking) and Lane Assist (lane support with emergency lane keeping), as fitted to the Tesla Model 3 (2019)
deployed by: Tesla (standard on the Model 3 in Australia and New Zealand)
measured against: Every other car that ANCAP had rated against the same protocols
costs and harms: In ANCAP's highway-speed tests the emergency braking avoided or mitigated collisions in most scenarios, not all. It scored 2.47 of 3 points there and 5.56 of 6 points for pedestrians.

benefit: Upstart lends to more people with low credit scores, at lower rates
AI system or service: Upstart Network underwriting and pricing model
deployed by: Upstart Network, Inc.
measured against: a hypothetical model using traditional application and credit file variables without machine learning
without the AI: approval rate and average APRs of the traditional model (not quantified)
with the AI: approves 27% more applicants than the traditional model, and yields 16% lower average APRs for approved loans
costs and harms: In 2024 the independent monitor found approval disparities for Black applicants that were statistically significant and large enough to matter in practice. In February 2020 the Student Borrower Protection Center reported on a test with hypothetical graduates. Upstart quoted a Howard University graduate nearly $3,499 more over a five-year loan than a similar graduate of New York University. Upstart rejected the monitor's proposed less discriminatory alternative model.

benefit: AFR Locate led South Wales Police to act in 37 cases
vendor: NEC (now North Gate Public Services (UK) Ltd)
AI system or service: AFR Locate, using NEC's NeoFace Watch software
deployed by: South Wales Police
measured against: Existing methods of locating wanted people
without the AI: had not been capable of location by existing methods
costs and harms: Around 500,000 faces may have been scanned over 50 deployments, and most people scanned were not suspected of wrongdoing. At Queen Street, 2 of 10 possible matches were not true matches. The court said that the technology gives pause for thought because of its potential to affect privacy rights.

benefit: Apple Watch Fall Detection calls 911 after a hiker falls about 30 feet
AI system or service: Apple Watch Fall Detection
deployed by: not in the sources
measured against: not in the sources
costs and harms: No cost or harm from this rescue is reported. Apple's support page notes that the watch cannot detect all falls and that it may read high-impact activity as a fall and trigger Fall Detection.

benefit: EasyScan GO reaches 91.1% sensitivity for malaria at 11 sites
vendor: Intellectual Ventures' Global Good Fund (software and original hardware); Motic (production prototype device, software licensed to Motic)
AI system or service: EasyScan GO digital malaria microscopy device with convolutional-neural-network image analysis of thick blood films
deployed by: Research sites in 11 countries under a multi-center study with University of Oxford / Mahidol-Oxford Tropical Medicine Research Unit-affiliated investigators (research use, not routine service)
measured against: expert microscopy
with the AI: diagnostic sensitivity of the EasyScan Go device was 91.1% (95% CI 88.9–92.7) and specificity was 75.6% (95% CI 73.1–78.0)
costs and harms: Poor slide quality and low parasite density could undermine results, and imprecise parasite counts limited use for measuring infection intensity. The authors of the London study found that the device classified every non-falciparum infection as P. vivax.

benefit: Letrus essay feedback lifts Brazilian students' exam essay scores
AI system or service: Letrus automated writing evaluation (AWE) platform, with machine-learning essay scoring and automated feedback (tested alone and with human graders)
deployed by: Espírito Santo State Education Department (SEDU/ES) with Letrus, in 110 public high schools
measured against: Students in 68 comparison schools without the platform
without the AI: Comparison schools' ENEM essay scores (the reference level)
with the AI: 0.094 standard deviations higher in schools with either version of the system
costs and harms: The enhanced version paid hired human graders 3.50 reais per essay, took about three business days to return grades, and would entail large hiring and monitoring costs to expand. J-PAL calls the human grading component expensive and hard to scale. Both costs bought no extra gain in scores.

benefit: GI Genius helped endoscopists find more adenomas in a randomized trial
AI system or service: GI Genius
deployed by: Humanitas Research Hospital, Nuovo Regina Margherita Hospital and Valduce Hospital (AID trial)
measured against: Standard white-light colonoscopy in the same trial
costs and harms: FDA reviewers noted a risk of more unnecessary extractions. GI Genius had a lower positive percent agreement, though not significantly. They also flagged possible overreliance on the software. Denmark's Health Technology Council, reviewing computer-aided detection in general, warned of unnecessary tissue samples, extra hospital work and overtreatment.

benefit: Abstrackr catches studies that a lone reviewer wrongly excluded
vendor: Brown University, Center for Evidence Synthesis in Health
AI system or service: Abstrackr (machine learning citation screening)
deployed by: AHRQ's University of Alberta Evidence-based Practice Center (retrospective simulations on three reviews)
measured against: A single reviewer's screening without the tool, checked against dual independent screening
with the AI: 33–90% of records erroneously excluded by a single reviewer identified
costs and harms: Used to exclude studies automatically, Abstrackr missed a median 5% of relevant studies, and up to 28% in one review. Combined with a single reviewer, it still missed a median 1%. The authors say that the savings of automated screening came with a higher risk of wrongly excluding relevant studies.

benefit: e-Child Happiness flagged 14 abused children whom a rule left out
vendor: Ministry of Health and Welfare (보건복지부), with data processing by the Korea Social Security Information Service (사회보장정보원)
AI system or service: e아동행복지원시스템 (e-Child Happiness Support System) risk prediction model
deployed by: Ministry of Health and Welfare, with local government officials who visit the selected households
measured against: The 422 lower-scoring children who were selected while the exclusion rule applied
without the AI: No confirmed abuse case among the 422 lower-scoring children
with the AI: 14 confirmed abuse cases among the 422 higher-scoring children whom the rule had excluded
costs and harms: The ministry's exclusion rule kept 422 higher-risk children, 14 of them later confirmed abused, out of the program's home visits. The board warned that this risked losing the chance to find children in crisis early. No spending or error rate for the model is reported.

benefit: La Bonne Boîte tips lift short-term hiring a little in France
vendor: Pôle emploi, now France Travail (La Bonne Boîte), with the study's authors (recommendation design)
AI system or service: La Bonne Boîte (LBB) hiring predictions, with firm recommendations sent by email
deployed by: Pôle emploi, now France Travail, with the study's authors, in an emailing experiment with about 800,000 registered job seekers
measured against: About 300,000 registered job seekers in the control group, who received no emails
without the AI: Baseline job finding rate in short-term contracts of 0.15 over four months
costs and harms: The authors warn that recommendations can create congestion, with a risk of steering job seekers to a firm or local labor market beyond its hiring potential.

benefit: Release Assessment recommends release alike across races in NYC
vendor: New York City Criminal Justice Agency with Luminosity, Inc. and the University of Chicago Crime Lab
AI system or service: CJA Release Assessment (updated 2019)
deployed by: New York City Criminal Justice Agency, for the New York City Criminal Courts
measured against: The 2003 CJA Release Assessment, on the same 2009 to 2015 arrests
without the AI: 9.4 percentage points spread in release recommendation rates across races
costs and harms: The independent study found that judges' decisions are producing racially inequitable outcomes for people with comparable chances of returning to court. Among people charged with violent felonies who were recommended for release, judges set bail for 44% of Black people and 29% of white people. Of released people recommended for release, 90% attended every court date.

benefit: Computer-read chest X-rays speed TB treatment at a Malawi clinic
AI system or service: CAD4TB computer-aided detection software reading digital chest X-rays
deployed by: PROSPECT trial team of the Malawi-Liverpool-Wellcome Trust Clinical Research Programme at Bangwe Health Centre
measured against: Standard care for adults with cough at the same clinic
without the AI: 0 of 5 TB patients treated on the day of the visit; median 11 days to treatment
with the AI: 6 of 15 TB patients treated on the day of the visit; median 1 day to treatment
costs and harms: The X-ray package added US$19.92 per participant screened. The authors estimated a 0% probability that it was cost-effective at US$1,200 per quality-adjusted life year over 56 days. A Malaysian health technology assessment reported US$4,620.47 per quality-adjusted life year gained for the X-ray package.

benefit: A demand-routing app helps less skilled taxi drivers find fares
vendor: A tech company that the authors do not name
AI system or service: AI Navi (machine-learning demand forecasting and route suggestion for taxi drivers)
deployed by: The same company, which gave the app to about 500 drivers at taxi firms in Yokohama
measured against: The same drivers cruising with the app turned off
with the AI: 5% shorter on average; 7% shorter for low-skilled drivers; skill gap narrowed by 13.4%
costs and harms: The effect for high-skilled drivers was nearly zero or even negative, though not statistically significant. The authors raise a concern that drivers in an area could compete for the same customers and engage in business stealing if the market size stays constant.

benefit: Heavy-vehicle fleets credit Guardian with fewer lapses at the wheel
vendor: Seeing Machines (Guardian), with other FDDT suppliers such as SmartCap
AI system or service: Seeing Machines Guardian and other fatigue and distraction detection technologies (FDDTs) in trucks and buses
deployed by: 12 Australian road freight and bus operators interviewed for the NHVR trial, listed in the report's Appendix B
measured against: Managing fatigue through prescriptive hours-of-work rules and work diaries
without the AI: current hours of work laws (e.g. Standard Hours/BFM) did not enable operators to discriminate between safe and unsafe driving with any degree of certainty
with the AI: the fatigue detection technologies provided better and more appropriate information in order to help them differentiate between safe and unsafe driving
costs and harms: Installation cost about $2,000 to $2,500 per vehicle, plus $80 to $100 a month for monitoring. One operator needed about 0.5 FTE for monitoring. Drivers were highly sensitive to surveillance and privacy issues. False positives were significant during implementation.

benefit: ShotSpotter alerts got Camden gunshot victims to hospital sooner
AI system or service: ShotSpotter gunshot detection system
deployed by: Camden County Police Department
measured against: Shootings in Camden in which ShotSpotter was not activated
costs and harms: The study reports no costs or harms for Camden. SoundThinking's page reports a customer-reported false positive rate under 0.5 percent across all its customers in 2019 to 2021, a general claim that is not specific to Camden.

benefit: Three FDIC models including SCOR flag 67 of 244 banks later downgraded
AI system or service: Statistical CAMELS Offsite Rating (SCOR), SCOR-Lag and Growth Monitoring System (GMS) offsite monitoring models
deployed by: Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation, Division of Risk Management Supervision (Case Managers in six Regional Offices)
measured against: not in the sources
costs and harms: The Offsite Review Program missed 150 of the 244 downgraded banks, often for weak management or credit administration that Call Report data do not reveal. Of 1,665 reviews prompted by the models' list, 97 percent left the supervisory strategy unchanged. Some FDIC staff said a first-time review could take 12 hours.

benefit: Nuru phone app identifies cassava disease better than extension agents
vendor: PlantVillage, Pennsylvania State University, with FAO, IITA, CIMMYT and others
AI system or service: PlantVillage Nuru cassava model (deep-learning object detection)
deployed by: IITA field evaluation with extension officers and farmers in Busia County, Kenya, and in Tanzania
measured against: agricultural extension agents and farmers diagnosing the same cassava symptoms
costs and harms: The practical result depended on examining several leaves and on visible symptoms. Accuracy rose to 74–88% with six leaves per plant but fell to 13–37% for mild symptoms.

benefit: Prompts in Australia's myTax lead taxpayers to adjust unusual claims
vendor: Australian Taxation Office (in-house data and analytics)
AI system or service: ATO myTax real-time analytics prompts using nearest-neighbor comparison models
deployed by: Australian Taxation Office
measured against: Taxpayers who did not receive a nudge message in the ATO's randomized control trial for the 2023-24 income year
with the AI: 2.5 times more likely to review their return and 3 times more likely to adjust their data
costs and harms: No cost or harm to taxpayers is documented. The ATO says that it is cautious about adding more messages because more messages may weaken their effect.

benefit: Catalina chatbot answers over 164,900 COVID-19 chats in Ecuador
AI system or service: Catalina COVID-19 chatbot on Government of Ecuador webpages
deployed by: Government of Ecuador (Ministry of Telecommunications and the Information Society, MINTEL) with UNDP, which led the initiative, and other UN agencies
measured against: not in the sources
costs and harms: 1MillionBot reports that Catalina answered with an 89% accuracy rate, which leaves about 11% of answers inaccurate.

benefit: Updated Allegheny Family Screening Tool precedes fewer home removals
vendor: Not named in the evaluation (built for the Allegheny County Department of Human Services)
AI system or service: Allegheny Family Screening Tool, LASSO version (predictive risk model for child welfare hotline screening)
deployed by: Allegheny County Department of Human Services, Office of Children, Youth and Families
measured against: General protective service episodes before any tool, January 2015 to July 2016
with the AI: 180-day risk of home removal after a screen-in 2.7 percentage points lower
costs and harms: Acceptance for services after screen-in fell by 8 percentage points. Some racial differences in 180-day outcomes widened. An ACLU audit found that, measured as the county uses the tool, it sometimes had lower accuracy, a higher false positive rate and greater racial disparities.

benefit: RCRA predictive targeting model spots violations more efficiently
vendor: University of Chicago Energy & Environment Lab, with EPA staff
AI system or service: Machine-learning model that forecasts RCRA violations by large quantity generator (LQG) hazardous waste facilities, tested in the RCRA Data Analytics Evaluation
deployed by: EPA regional offices, coordinated by EPA's Office of Enforcement and Compliance Assurance
measured against: Status quo inspection targeting practices across EPA regions
with the AI: a substantial increase in efficiency of detecting hazardous waste violations
costs and harms: not in the sources

benefit: DEEPVESSEL FFR judged better than CT angiography in China's review
vendor: Keya Medical, with 北京昆仑医云科技有限公司 (Beijing Kunlun Medical Cloud Technology Co., Ltd.) as the applicant in China
AI system or service: DEEPVESSEL FFR (冠脉血流储备分数计算软件)
deployed by: 北京昆仑医云科技有限公司 (Beijing Kunlun Medical Cloud Technology Co., Ltd.), the applicant (prospective trial at three institutions and retrospective trial at six)
measured against: Coronary CT angiography alone, in CMDE's statement of the main clinical benefit, which gives no figures
costs and harms: CMDE names two main risks. False-positive results could lead to unnecessary invasive angiography and coronary intervention. False-negative results could delay angiography and intervention and lead to adverse cardiovascular events. CMDE said that residual risks need further evaluation in clinical use.

benefit: DBLG1 closed loop kept glucose in range longer in a French trial
AI system or service: DBLG1 System
deployed by: 12 French diabetes centers in the SP7 randomized crossover trial
measured against: Open-loop systems in which an insulin pump and a glucose sensor work independently
without the AI: 59,4 (± 1,3) % of time in 70-180 mg/dL with pump and sensor in the SP7 trial
with the AI: 68,5 (± 1,2) % with DBLG1, rated amélioration modérée du service attendu (ASA III)
costs and harms: Technical incidents with the Cellnovo pump led to a protocol amendment that replaced it with the Kaleido pump. Starting treatment requires intensive training in hospital, and the diabetes team at the initiating center must provide medical on-call cover around the clock.

benefit: Eight people walk away after two Tesla Model X cars stop as an oak falls
AI system or service: Tesla Autopilot driver-assistance suite with Automatic Emergency Braking, on two Model X cars
deployed by: not in the sources
measured against: the driver's own reaction without automatic braking
without the AI: the driver says that he could not have reacted in time and that a further second would have put the car under the tree
with the AI: the car stopped with the trunk on the bonnet and all occupants survived
costs and harms: The Brentwood driver's wife had two black eyes and bruising, and the other car's passengers were sore from the seatbelts. Both cars were written off.

benefit: An MIT neural network flags halicin, which treats infections in mice
vendor: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (Collins and Barzilay laboratories) with the Broad Institute
AI system or service: Directed-message-passing neural network (D-MPNN) for antibacterial activity prediction (Chemprop-style, MIT)
deployed by: MIT / Broad Institute / McMaster University research teams
measured against: a vehicle control and metronidazole, the first-line antibiotic, in mice infected with Clostridioides difficile
without the AI: vehicle or the antibiotic metronidazole (lower clearance rate)
with the AI: sterilization of 3 out of 4 mice after 72 hr of treatment, and 4 out of 4 mice after 96 hr of treatment
costs and harms: In the study of 2024, the authors report weight loss and slight kidney inflammation in rats at a high dose, and they found that halicin is poorly absorbed. No harms to people appear in the sources, which show no trial in people.

benefit: Locust control using eLocust3m data may have averted USD 1.56 billion
vendor: PlantVillage, Pennsylvania State University, with FAO
AI system or service: eLocust3m (PlantVillage) with AI data validation feeding FAO's Desert Locust Information Service
deployed by: FAO Desert Locust Information Service and national locust control operations in Kenya, Ethiopia and Somalia
measured against: no locust control operations in East Africa (FAO's estimate of the losses that the control campaign averted)
without the AI: loss of 4 million tonnes of cereal and 800 million litres of milk production, USD 1.56 billion in cereal and milk losses
with the AI: those losses prevented and the food security of 36.6 million people protected
costs and harms: FAO says that nearly 25 percent of the data it received was unusable or incorrect. The first real-time evaluation found that data quality problems with the eLocust3m phone app had not been overcome. It cited photos with no location and data on non-locust pests. Some stakeholders questioned whether the app was more of a hindrance than a tool.

benefit: Tesla Autopilot brakes while steering clear of a wrong-way driver
AI system or service: Tesla Autopilot on a 2020 Model S, with TeslaCam dashcam recording
deployed by: not in the sources
measured against: The driver's own unaided reaction
without the AI: Peters had not yet seen the oncoming car or touched the brake
with the AI: The car had braked and begun a lane change to the right
costs and harms: not in the sources

benefit: Lunit INSIGHT CXR flags 13 resectable lung cancers on routine X-rays
AI system or service: Lunit INSIGHT CXR
deployed by: Yongin Severance Hospital, Yonsei University College of Medicine
measured against: The radiologists' official reports on the same radiographs; the study has no group without AI
without the AI: Radiologists' reports described a lung abnormality in 12 of 13 patients and read no active lung disease in one
with the AI: The software flagged a nodule in all 13 patients
costs and harms: Editor's note: Most formal reports also found the abnormality, so those cases suggest a timing advantage rather than unique detection. The discordant report supports a different, supplementary detection role for one patient.

benefit: In a simulation, Fujitsu software helps controllers warn ships sooner
AI system or service: Fujitsu Human Centric AI Zinrai collision-risk prediction using AIS and radar data
deployed by: Japan Coast Guard, Tokyo Wan Vessel Traffic Service Center (trial)
measured against: conventional control operation without AI risk information, in a simulation of past near-miss cases
with the AI: risk warning sent an average of approximately two minutes earlier; number of warnings issued for risk-prone vessels nearly doubled
costs and harms: Editor's note: The trial counted warnings and their timing without measuring collisions avoided or the operational cost of additional warnings.

benefit: Google software grades Thai diabetic eye photos as well as specialists
AI system or service: Google Health deep-learning diabetic retinopathy screening system
deployed by: Thailand national diabetic retinopathy screening program (Ministry of Public Health guidelines) with Rajavithi Hospital, Bangkok
measured against: regional retina specialist over-readers, measured against an adjudicated reference standard from fellowship-trained retina specialists
with the AI: an accuracy of 94·7% (95% CI 93·0-96·2), sensitivity of 91·4% (87·1-95·0), and specificity of 95·4% (94·1-96·7)
costs and harms: Rejection of images for poor quality required repeat photography and sometimes unnecessary referrals. Slow or failed internet connections delayed screening, despite rapid grading when connectivity worked.

benefit: Camera software flags a passenger staggering at an Odakyu platform edge
vendor: Panasonic System Solutions Japan, with Odakyu Electric Railway
AI system or service: 転落検知システム (fall detection system): Panasonic image-analysis and deep-learning on existing station cameras
deployed by: Odakyu Electric Railway
measured against: platform doors, the measure that Odakyu wanted to replace with its existing cameras because the doors need platform reinforcement work
without the AI: no automatic alert to the station office when a person fell or lingered at the platform edge
with the AI: an alert with camera video on a terminal in the station office, so that staff can stop trains
costs and harms: The vendor reports misdetections caused by sunlight. It gives neither their number nor the staff time that they took.

benefit: Court accepts Spirit's Predict review stopped at 85% recall
vendor: Not named in the orders, which say that Spirit's e-discovery vendor Legility offers the tool
AI system or service: Predict, a technology-assisted review tool that uses continuous active learning
deployed by: Spirit AeroSystems, Inc. (defendant), with its e-discovery vendor Legility and its law firm
measured against: Any other form of review
costs and harms: Spirit spent about $600,000 in vendor and attorney fees on the Predict review to produce fewer than 10,000 responsive documents. About 800 documents that Spirit identified as responsive were not produced because the review stopped at 85% recall.

benefit: AI Guardian helps remove 7,853 illegal wildlife postings
AI system or service: AI Guardian
deployed by: IFAW
measured against: IFAW's earlier manual and keyword monitoring of online wildlife trade
with the AI: Images flagged by the tool for review and reporting
costs and harms: In the 2020 test the tool had a 75% accuracy rate for recognizing images. Labeling the training images took large labor costs and expert knowledge. Products that imitate wildlife items can look so alike that even professionals misidentify them.

benefit: London court declines to revisit Musst's TAR of 175,723 documents
AI system or service: Technology assisted review by predictive coding and clustering analytics
deployed by: Musst, with its then solicitors Bird & Bird
measured against: not in the sources
costs and harms: Musst used technology assisted review without telling Astra, which the court called a failure of process. The judgment refers to an estimated cost of the review but does not state it.

benefit: Olelo phone captions beat human-assisted ones in tests for the FCC
vendor: MachineGenius, Inc. (speech recognition licensed from an unnamed vendor)
AI system or service: Olelo, MachineGenius's ASR-only Internet Protocol Captioned Telephone Service (IP CTS)
deployed by: MachineGenius, Inc.
measured against: CA-assisted IP CTS providers, tested on the same call scenarios in 2018 and 2019
costs and harms: MITRE measured average word error rates of 2.7% to 8.2% for the ASR-only captions. The commenter CaptionCall argued that ASR may generate inaccurate captions and does not work equally well for all individuals or call environments. The FCC answered that its standards do not require perfect service quality.

benefit: AI teams out-earn growers in Wageningen's greenhouse challenges
vendor: International competing teams; challenge organized by Wageningen University & Research and funded by Tencent
AI system or service: Team AI algorithms in the Autonomous Greenhouse Challenge (2020: Automatoes, AiCU, DIGILOG, IUA.CAAS, The Automators)
deployed by: Wageningen University & Research greenhouse compartments, Bleiswijk
measured against: a compartment run by experienced Dutch growers in the same facility
without the AI: the growers' sellable yield and net profit in 2018
with the AI: 6% more sellable yield and 17% more net profit for the winning algorithm
costs and harms: Editor's note: The comparison used identical high-technology compartments with extensive actuators and sensors. The advantage therefore presupposed that physical infrastructure, beyond the competing algorithms.

benefit: Tesla Model 3 steadies a Belgian baker's swerve around a wild boar
AI system or service: Tesla Autopilot (with the active safety features it powers)
deployed by: not in the sources
measured against: driving without Autopilot, as the driver recalls from an earlier crash
without the AI: a bad crash in a normal car without Autopilot, by the driver's account of an earlier event
with the AI: the car straightened its course after his swerve, by his account
costs and harms: Editor's note: Van Hoesen described feeling the wheel work against him, making coordination between driver and assistance a material issue in this event.

benefit: Cognoa ASD Diagnosis Aid matched specialists when it gave a result
AI system or service: Cognoa ASD Diagnosis Aid
deployed by: Fourteen US sites in the Cognoa ASD Diagnosis Aid validation study
measured against: Specialist diagnosis validated by blinded central reviewers
with the AI: PPV 81%, NPV 98%, sensitivity 98%, specificity 79% among determinate outputs
costs and harms: Fifteen children in the study received a false positive result. The device needs a smartphone, which some low-income families lack. New York's committee heard evidence that the algorithm performs better with white male children. The average wholesale price is $2,280 per evaluation.

benefit: CaptionMate tops assisted captions for accuracy in four of five tests
AI system or service: CaptionMate, Clarity's ASR-only Internet Protocol Captioned Telephone Service (IP CTS) app
deployed by: Clarity Products, LLC
measured against: Average error rates of CA-assisted providers on the same call scenarios
with the AI: 6.3% to 35.9% (Clarity's median error rates), lower in four of five scenarios
costs and harms: Clarity's median word error rates ran from 6.3 percent to 35.9 percent, while providers with human assistants ranged from 8.9 percent to 19.5 percent. The 35.9 percent figure came from the noise-canceling scenario. The FCC bars any provider from letting its speech recognition retain the content of users' calls.

benefit: Machine learning maps where desert locusts may breed in East Africa
vendor: International Center of Insect Physiology and Ecology (icipe) with DLCO-EA, Kenya Plant Protection Services and FAO co-authors
AI system or service: MaxEnt ecological-niche model of desert locust breeding (Kimathi et al.)
deployed by: None documented (research model)
measured against: presence records from Mauritania and Saudi Arabia that were withheld from building the Morocco model
without the AI: known breeding sites not used in model development
with the AI: mean predicted suitability of 0.85 at the Mauritanian sites and 0.84 at the Saudi sites
costs and harms: Editor's note: The training locations were in Morocco, Mauritania, and Saudi Arabia, whereas the intended projections were in different countries. A held-out split of the source records does not directly test that geographical transfer.

benefit: Colombia's Constitutional Court adopts PretorIA to sort tutela rulings
vendor: Corte Constitucional de Colombia with the Universidad de Buenos Aires (IALAB, Juan Corvalán) and the Universidad del Rosario
AI system or service: PretorIA (Corte Constitucional tutela classification and search system, derived from Argentina's Prometea)
deployed by: Corte Constitucional de Colombia
measured against: a person reading tutela files by hand to find the chamber's selection criterion
without the AI: una persona tarda al menos un día para leer 30 expedientes
with the AI: el sistema puede procesar las sentencias en medio digital en menos de 2 minutos
costs and harms: The proof of concept listed variables that can create bias in machine learning as a lesson learned. Defining and testing the classification rules took much time. Reliability was 92% in the pilot and 80% in the implementation phase. The way the process was presented to the public generated confusion.

benefit: AIDRscreening met its targets for retinopathy in China's review
vendor: Shenzhen SiBionics Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. (深圳硅基智能科技有限公司)
AI system or service: AIDRscreening (糖尿病视网膜病变眼底图像辅助诊断软件)
deployed by: Shenzhen SiBionics Intelligent Technology (prospective multicenter and retrospective registration trials)
measured against: Senior doctors' readings as the gold standard, with preset accuracy targets
with the AI: Diagnostic accuracy reached the targets (no figures given)
costs and harms: CMDE warns that poor checks of image quality may cause missed or wrong diagnoses, and that AIDRscreening has some false-negative probability, so a patient told that no retinopathy is seen may face delayed diagnosis and treatment without regular follow-up.

benefit: Airdoc-AIFUNDUS met its targets for retinopathy in China's review
vendor: Shanghai Airdoc Medical Technology Co., Ltd. (上海鹰瞳医疗科技有限公司)
AI system or service: Airdoc-AIFUNDUS (糖尿病视网膜病变眼底图像辅助诊断软件)
deployed by: Shanghai Airdoc Medical Technology (prospective multicenter registration trial)
measured against: Preset targets for sensitivity and specificity, with senior doctors' reading as the reference standard
without the AI: Preset targets that the report does not state
with the AI: Sensitivity and specificity reached the targets
costs and harms: CMDE lists the risks. The software may misdiagnose or miss disease even when used correctly, more so with poor images. False negatives could delay diagnosis and treatment. False positives could add needless worry and waste medical resources. Uploading patient data and images to a cloud server carries a risk of leaks.

benefit: Fitbit Charge 3 signals precede 4 of 5 COVID-19 exacerbations
vendor: Fitbit (device and EOV algorithm); Kanazawa University investigators (signal definitions)
AI system or service: Fitbit Charge 3 estimated oxygen variation (EOV) and resting heart rate, with investigator-defined signal thresholds
deployed by: Kanazawa University and JCHO Kanazawa Hospital (DEXTERITY pilot, UMIN000041421)
measured against: high resting-heart-rate (RHR) signals from the same Fitbit data
without the AI: the sensitivity and specificity of high RHR signals were 50% and 80%, respectively
costs and harms: The authors report no cost or harm to participants. Elderly patients who could not use a smartphone were not enrolled. The authors note that the device's functions and analysis algorithms were not approved as a medical device at the time.

benefit: KLD truck component inspection system measures railcar parts at CSX
AI system or service: KLD truck component inspection system (AxleScan and TruckScan modules)
deployed by: FRA and Association of American Railroads test installation at CSX Transportation's Hague site south of Waycross, Georgia (revenue service, December 2016 to December 2018)
measured against: not in the sources
costs and harms: Uptime averaged 80 percent against a 99 percent requirement, with hut air-conditioner failures and a nine-day AxleScan outage. Broken-spring detection carried a 1.5–8.5 percent false positive rate. The project stopped short of methods to broadcast alerts to the railroad.

benefit: Andhra Pradesh reports 92% accuracy for its Vidyarthi Nestham model
vendor: Andhra Pradesh School Education department, with support from Microsoft
AI system or service: Vidyarthi Nestham dropout prediction model
deployed by: Andhra Pradesh School Education department (pilot in 10,000 government schools)
measured against: not in the sources
costs and harms: The review notes that detailed data on each individual in the student information system that feeds the model has raised issues of privacy and individual rights. Each teacher in the pilot is assigned up to five predicted dropouts and must report on them every fortnight. The review found no negative consequences but did not rule them out.

benefit: Confirmed TREWS sepsis alerts are linked to 3.3% lower mortality
AI system or service: TREWS (Targeted Real-time Early Warning System)
deployed by: Johns Hopkins Medicine (five hospitals)
measured against: alerted sepsis patients whose alert was not confirmed by a provider within 3 h
without the AI: patients whose alert was not confirmed by a provider within 3 h
with the AI: reduced in-hospital mortality rate (3.3%, confidence interval (CI) 1.7, 5.1%, adjusted absolute reduction, and 18.7%, CI 9.4, 27.0%, adjusted relative reduction)
costs and harms: Editor's note: The comparison was observational and conditioned on a clinician response rather than random assignment. Adjustment helps but cannot remove every difference associated with response timing.

benefit: Whale Safe grades ship cooperation with 10-knot slowdowns
vendor: Benioff Ocean Science Laboratory, UC Santa Barbara (platform); Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution (buoy detection system)
AI system or service: Whale Safe: moored acoustic buoy with onboard call detection and classification (Baumgartner et al. 2019 system) plus sightings and habitat model, with AIS-based ship cooperation grading
deployed by: Benioff Ocean Science Laboratory with The Marine Mammal Center (San Francisco) and NOAA partners
measured against: not in the sources
costs and harms: The authors of the 2019 paper report false detection rates of 0% to nearly 0%. They report daily missed detection rates of 12% to 42% for a Massachusetts buoy. In their 2026 paper, the Whale Safe team and its data partners report that the California buoys were offline for more than a year in total in each region. For those periods, the Whale Presence Rating had no acoustic input.

benefit: Court backs Chicago's Active Learning review of 1.3 million pages
AI system or service: Relativity Active Learning (AL)
deployed by: City of Chicago (defendant) and its attorneys
measured against: Manual review or keyword searches
costs and harms: The court agreed that Active Learning lets reviewers set aside documents that the software finds likely nonresponsive, and that such documents are typically neither reviewed nor produced. Plaintiffs argued that culling before TAR would eliminate relevant emails. The parties had already spent nearly a year litigating the search protocol.

benefit: Autopilot on the Model 3 assists best but engages drivers weakly
AI system or service: Autopilot, as fitted to the Tesla Model 3 (2020)
deployed by: Tesla (factory-fitted and updated over the air)
measured against: not in the sources
costs and harms: Euro NCAP says that the Model 3 pairs a high level of assistance with weak driver engagement, which may lead to overreliance. The system resists the driver's steering and then disengages. The cabin camera is not used to monitor the driver. The name Autopilot suggests full automation.

benefit: X100 with Full Field PBS matched manual microscopy on 645 smears
AI system or service: X100 with Full Field Peripheral Blood Smear Application
deployed by: Scopio Labs (method comparison against manual microscopy at three sites)
measured against: Manual light microscopy of the same 645 specimens
with the AI: Agreement 96.29%, sensitivity 87.86% and specificity 97.62% for white-cell differentials
costs and harms: Against manual microscopy, the examiner-reviewed results had a sensitivity of 87.86% for white-cell abnormalities, so about one in eight abnormalities found by manual microscopy was missed.

benefit: Darpan matches a missing boy to a child home in Assam after five years
AI system or service: Darpan face-recognition portal for missing and found children
deployed by: Telangana State Police, with Goalpara Police (Assam) and Handia Police Station (Allahabad, Uttar Pradesh)
measured against: the five years that the boy spent unidentified in a child welfare center in Assam
without the AI: Missing from Allahabad since 14 July 2015 and in a child welfare center at Goalpara since 23 July 2015, unidentified
with the AI: Matched by Darpan and recognized in person by his parents by 9 October 2020
costs and harms: The Tribune notes that facial recognition in Telangana faced severe backlash earlier in 2020, when it was used to tackle fraudulent voting.

benefit: CoronaryDoc met its targets for triage of stenosis in China's review
vendor: Yukun (Beijing) Network Technology Co., Ltd. (语坤（北京）网络科技有限公司)
AI system or service: CoronaryDoc (冠脉CT造影图像血管狭窄辅助分诊软件)
deployed by: Yukun (Beijing) Network Technology (retrospective blinded registration trial at three institutions)
measured against: Manual reading as the gold standard, with preset targets for sensitivity and specificity
with the AI: Sensitivity and specificity reached the targets (no figures given)
costs and harms: CMDE names one clinical risk. False negative triage results may delay diagnosis and treatment. CMDE limits use to trained physicians, bars use as the sole basis for care and excludes patients with acute chest pain.

benefit: Autopilot did the best lane keeping of 17 systems in CR's 2020 tests
AI system or service: Autopilot, as fitted to the Tesla Model Y (2020)
deployed by: Tesla (fitted to the Model Y)
measured against: The 16 other active driving assistance systems in the same Consumer Reports tests
without the AI: 8 of 10 or less for capability and performance
costs and harms: Consumer Reports found that Autopilot could be operated on residential roads with only a single center line. Its auto-steering resists a driver's input until significant torque is applied, then shuts off abruptly. Autopilot scored 3 of 10 for keeping the driver engaged. It scored 2 of 10 for making clear when it was safe to use.

benefit: A chat assistant helps new support agents resolve more issues
vendor: An AI customer-service software company that the authors do not name (the 'AI firm'), building on OpenAI's GPT models
AI system or service: Generative AI conversational assistant for customer support agents, built on OpenAI's GPT family with additional machine-learning models trained on customer-service conversations
deployed by: A Fortune 500 enterprise software company (unnamed) and its outsourced support contractors
measured against: Agents without access to the assistant
without the AI: Issues resolved per hour without access
with the AI: 15% more issues resolved per hour on average
costs and harms: The most experienced and highest-skilled agents saw small declines in resolution rates and customer satisfaction, and the authors suggest that the suggestions may distract top performers. benefit: Togo uses machine learning to send emergency cash to its rural poor
vendor: Innovations for Poverty Action, CEGA and UC Berkeley (Aiken and Blumenstock, UC Berkeley; Bellue, University of Mannheim; Karlan and Udry, Northwestern University) for the Government of Togo

benefit: Paige Prostate helped pathologists catch cancer missed on a first read

benefit: Apple Watch calls an ambulance for an unconscious motorcyclist

benefit: Dxcover blood test separated patients by whether they had brain cancer

The exploratory cost-effectiveness model assumed a test cost of £100 and a prevalence of 1%, and SHTG notes that the evidence rests on assumptions about prevalence and referral behavior.

benefit: Fewer suicidal acts on the tracks at Stockholm stations with AI-CCTV

deployed by: Storstockholms Lokaltrafik (SL), the regional public transport authority

benefit: Google model predicts the lost colors of Klimt's destroyed paintings

with the AI: a digital reconstruction of his Faculty works — in full and glorious color

benefit: Bonn orchestra premieres Beethoven's Tenth, completed with AI help

with the AI: a complete symphony, with third and fourth movements generated with the AI, premiered on 9 October 2021

benefit: Checks by monitoring help Flanders prevent overpayments of farm aid
vendor: The paying agency of Belgium (Flanders), following technical guidelines from the European Commission's Joint Research Centre

benefit: Bell uses AI to block over a billion fraudulent calls in Canada
AI system or service: Bell Canada's network-level call-blocking system for fraudulent and scam voice calls (AI anomaly flagging with review)

benefit: Faculty's bed tool for Kettering goes open source without being deployed

benefit: See & Spray reduces herbicide use in soybean trials
AI system or service: John Deere See & Spray (machine-vision targeted sprayer)

without the AI: full broadcast applications of the postemergence herbicides (traditional broadcast program)

benefit: CreditConnect-EV helps finance over 20,000 electric two-wheelers
AI system or service: AIZEN CreditConnect-EV
deployed by: AIZEN and lending partners

without the AI: riders and fleet operators without affordable credit for electric two-wheelers
with the AI: more than 20,000 electric two-wheelers financed since 2022, by the developer's count
costs and harms: No cost or harm to borrowers or lenders has been reported. Nothing shows that the same harm occurred here.

benefit: AI-guided robots that park cars could raise the capacity of garages

vendor: Eviden (Atos Group), maker of AIsaac. The service is supplied under contract 800961753 by Teliko Solutions, S.A.P.I. de C.V. and Grupo Vanguardia en Información y Conocimiento, S.A. de C.V.

benefit: SmartKit AI alerts cut a Newark federal building's capacity charges
AI system or service: SmartKit AI (operator-in-the-loop grid-interactive efficient building software)
deployed by: U.S. General Services Administration, 20 Washington Place, Newark
measured against: The building's average monthly maximum load from June to September 2022

Some of those alerts were false positives from utility spikes. Alerts arrived at night and in quick succession, and staff asked to turn off the indoor air quality alerts.

benefit: Parkeercontrole scan cars lift Rotterdam's rate of paid parking to 90%
vendor: Arvoo (cameras and image-recognition software) with the Gemeente Rotterdam (ISA application, built by its ESO team at BCO)

benefit: Malha Fina clears 27% of school-meal accounts at Brazil's FNDE

benefit: MSB Customer Anomaly Detection flags two firms with weak due diligence

benefit: Prefectures find 病害虫診断AI 80% accurate on new pest images

benefit: Doctors find lung cancer after a smartwatch flags a fast heart rate
vendor: Not stated (the report does not name the device's maker)

They cite a study in which only 153 of 2,161 smartwatch alerts of an irregular rhythm led to a confirmed arrhythmia.

benefit: Android alerts reach phones in Alanya seconds before an offshore quake

benefit: Face2Gene lists a rare disorder that sequencing confirms after 18 years

benefit: ScamShield flags about 5 million suspected scam texts in Singapore

benefit: A predicted model solves a hard crystal structure

benefit: A VA trial ties STORM case reviews to lower odds of death

benefit: Google Translate adds Quechua, Aymara and Guarani

measured against: not in the sources

The Christian Science Monitor notes that cultural nuances may not translate. No cost figure is given.

benefit: After Meta flags a post, police visit a Paraguayan teen

deployed by: Meta Platforms
measured against: not in the sources
costs and harms: Officials responded to a worrying post with no evidence of a weapon or a developed plan of attack. They had to protect the minor's privacy and avoid undue suspicion of him.

benefit: An NVDA screenreader for blind pupils uses ABAIR's Irish voices

benefit: An early resistance warning helped doctors change a woman’s antibiotic

benefit: From Numbers to Names matches Holocaust survivors to archive photos

benefit: Minuteful - kidney test let lay users test their own urine albumin

Results may be falsely elevated in patients taking sodium bicarbonate or hydroxychloroquine in high concentrations. In UK studies, lack of a smartphone was a main reason for not taking part. Following up abnormal results was hard in patients who did not routinely engage with primary care.

benefit: EndoScreener lowered the rate of missed adenomas in China's review

benefit: Brain implant decodes a woman's attempted speech at 62 words per minute

benefit: Nantum control modeled to save 5% to 11% of a building's energy

benefit: Pregnant women in Kenya learn more from a text-message health service

benefit: MY-YD-01 raised detection of glaucoma-like damage on fundus photos

benefit: Pre-Collision Assist on the Mach-E brakes for pedestrians at night

costs and harms: not in the sources

benefit: Doctors find a pulmonary embolism after Apple Watch records low oxygen

benefit: On CT, PANDA detects pancreatic cancers that standard care missed

benefit: Huntsman's TAR review meets a special master's benchmark

benefit: Nigeria's biometric matching flags 2,780,756 registrations as ineligible

benefit: Avive AED exceeded the goals of the AHA for spotting shockable rhythms

benefit: CapisciAMe recognizes words from severely impaired speech

benefit: An Instagram alert about self-harm brings Satna police to a 17-year-old

costs and harms: The R$91.7 million is the value of corrected notices, and the savings are unproven.

benefit: FMF screening algorithm probably predicts preterm preeclampsia better
AI system or service: Fetal Medicine Foundation (FMF) first-trimester preeclampsia screening algorithm (maternal characteristics, mean arterial pressure, uterine artery pulsatility index and PlGF)
deployed by: Screening studies in Asia and Europe that FHI pooled, with screening proposed for Norway's specialist health service

FHI notes that all drugs, including aspirin, carry a possible risk of adverse events, and that the program would probably bring organizational consequences for maternity care.

benefit: NCAV and NLI chatbots bring calls from new survivors in Mongolia
AI system or service: NCAV and NLI domestic violence chatbots (AI-powered chatbot service on Facebook with mobile texting)

The NLI chatbot left 783 calls to operators, and the NCAV chatbot logged 451 unrecognized questions. Evaluators recommend improving voice commands and SMS messages to include more women and vulnerable groups.

benefit: An AI eye exam increased screening among young people with diabetes
AI system or service: IDx-DR (now LumineticsCore)
deployed by: Johns Hopkins Pediatric Diabetes Center
measured against: control arm given scripted referral and education with a paper handout

benefit: Fewer sepsis patients die after COMPOSER alerts UC San Diego nurses

AI system or service: COMPOSER deep-learning sepsis prediction and nurse alert system
deployed by: UC San Diego Health
measured against: Modeled post-deployment mortality without COMPOSER, using historical data and adjustment for confounders
costs and harms: Nurses received about 235 alerts a month across both sites. The sources show no evaluation of unnecessary treatment among patients without sepsis, or of its costs and harms.

benefit: Transpara helps Swedish breast screening find more cancers
AI system or service: Transpara
deployed by: Unilabs Mammography Unit at Skåne University Hospital with Lund University (MASAI trial, Swedish national screening program)
measured against: Standard double reading by two radiologists without AI

Its model of the MASAI approach in Region Skåne added an estimated 3.3 million kronor a year for 133,775 women at an AI price of 30 kronor per woman.

benefit: EMA backs the iBox score to forecast kidney graft loss in trials

benefit: FOX fits cochlear implants at least as well as manual fitting in a trial

with the AI: FOX arm at 3 months: median phoneme scores of 50%, 70% and 50% at the same levels

benefit: Software flags a severe artery blockage that a manual reading underrated

with the AI: a 72 percent AI probability of severe narrowing, then angiography that found a 99 percent stenosis of the left anterior descending artery
costs and harms: Editor's note: The model's reported specificity was 0.60, and its recommendation changed this patient's diagnostic pathway. A useful true-positive case does not remove the false-positive burden of the same policy.

benefit: Harvard authors report an AI tutor doubling median learning gains
vendor: Harvard University (Kestin, Miller, Klales, Milbourne, Ponti)

deployed by: Harvard University, Physical Sciences 2

benefit: A surgeon finds a tethered cord after ChatGPT narrows a mother's search
AI system or service: ChatGPT
deployed by: not in the sources
measured against: 17 physicians consulted over three years
without the AI: But the boy still had no diagnosis that explained all his symptoms.
with the AI: when ChatGPT suggested a diagnosis of tethered cord syndrome, 'it made a lot of sense,'
costs and harms: The mother said that ChatGPT gave three possible diagnoses and that parent stories on social media led her to tethered cord syndrome. The surgeon found the tethered cord on imaging and performed the operation. No harm from the use of ChatGPT appears in the sources.

benefit: Foncier innovant finds 140,000 undeclared pools in French aerial photos

with the AI: Dans toute la France, 140.000 piscines clandestines ont été repérées, ce qui va rapporter 40 millions d'euros.
costs and harms: Owners of detected pools bear the cost of the added tax. The Cour des comptes found that the tool produces many false positives that agents must clear, and a union official cited error rates of 55 to 60%.

benefit: Danish fraud models flag welfare cases that end with benefits cut

AI system or service: Udbetaling Danmark / ATP Den Faelles Dataenhed fraud-control models (about 60 profiling and machine-learning models as of 2019, including 'Really Single', 'Model Abroad' and 'Fictitious Employment')

with the AI: 33% of requested cases ended with revenue for Really Single, 7% for Model Abroad and 15% for the parental leave controls
costs and harms: In 2023, 54% of investigations opened on the models' flags ended with no further action for Really Single, almost 90% for Model Abroad and 65% for the parental-leave controls. Amnesty found the data collection neither necessary nor proportionate. It found that UDK's models risk discriminating against people with disabilities, migrants and low-income people. People investigated described a harmful psychological toll.

benefit: Morphing-BOT inspects over 30 km of water mains in four Korean towns
AI system or service: Morphing-BOT

without the AI: Inspection was labor-intensive and invasive and gave little real-time data, according to the developer.

costs and harms: The dataset's notes report a shortfall. Morphing I expected external sound recordings to differ at anomalies in the water mains, but they did not differ much between types of anomaly.

benefit: Deaf signers rank vivo's sign language avatar first
AI system or service: Vivo on-device accessibility suite
deployed by: Vivo
measured against: other sign language avatar systems in the CCL24 shared task, including the baseline system
without the AI: The baseline system from Beijing Tian Tang Technology scored 2.119 of 5.
costs and harms: Editor's note: Local execution removes a continuous-network dependency. It does not establish compatibility or task success across all devices, environments, and impairments.

with the AI: Four percentage points more likely to earn an A or B

They describe the main inputs as personnel, including a staff lead, a data analyst, teaching assistants and faculty, and technology-related materials. No harm to students is reported, and men in Microeconomics showed no effect.

benefit: TAAP points French state accountants to risky payment requests

costs and harms: not in the sources

They write that cost would balance sustainability only if the platform's contents did not need adjusting and the tool could stay installed on the participating schools' computers, and that adjustments would be needed given the lack of learning impact.

benefit: AI captures hate speech on radio for Liberia's iVerify fact-checkers

benefit: Sierra Leone's iVerify team handles 265 fact-checking requests
vendor: UNDP (Chief Digital Office and the Brussels-based Task Force on Electoral Assistance)
AI system or service: iVerify (UNDP fact-checking platform)
deployed by: Sierra Leone Association of Journalists, Independent Radio Network and BBC Media Action, with UNDP's elections project
measured against: not in the sources

A final evaluation of a related peacebuilding project said that iVerify's continuity hinges on external funding and internet infrastructure and that weak exit strategies challenge the continuity of results.

benefit: eMonitor+ findings reach Mozambique's election commission in 2023

deployed by: UNDP Mozambique's Enhancing Democracy and Electoral Processes (EDEP) project, staffed by UN Volunteers, for Mozambique's National Elections Commission (CNE)
measured against: not in the sources

benefit: qXR and Genki cut the cost of reading X-rays for TB in India
AI system or service: qXR and Genki (AI-assisted chest X-ray interpretation for TB screening)
deployed by: Public health facilities in Chennai, Tamil Nadu (Genki) and Maharashtra (qXR) screening for TB under India's National Tuberculosis Elimination Program
measured against: Digital chest X-ray reading by a radiologist
with the AI: INR 30 (USD 0.36) for qXR and INR 22 (USD 0.26) for Genki
costs and harms: The tools' pooled specificity from published studies was 68%, so 32% of people without TB would screen positive. Genki cost INR 283,108 a year per installation, or INR 1,698,648 for six Tamil Nadu centers. Health systems could pay at most INR 35 per reading for Genki and INR 410 for qXR.

benefit: Automatic phone captions cost $0.44 per minute less than assisted ones

deployed by: FCC-certified IP CTS providers paid from the Interstate TRS Fund (five were paid for IP CTS in 2023)
measured against: CA-assisted IP CTS, captioned with communications assistants, in 2023
costs and harms: At the single $1.30 rate, automatic captions earned a 116.7% operating margin in 2023, which the FCC called excessive compensation. The FCC said that keeping a single rate would likely reinforce an apparent incentive for providers to limit assisted captions, even for users who prefer them. It noted that speech recognition may transcribe some voices less accurately.

benefit: AI-BAC helped doctors find more breast lesions on mammograms
vendor: Deepwise (杭州深睿博联科技有限公司)
AI system or service: AI-BAC (乳腺X射线图像辅助检测软件)
deployed by: Deepwise (randomized crossover reader trial with 855 cases at three institutions)
measured against: The same doctors reading without the software, with three breast imaging experts' consensus as the reference
costs and harms: The CMDE names two main risks. A false positive can lead to unnecessary follow-up examinations. A false negative can lead to a missed breast lesion. It says that design and protective measures control these risks and that the instructions carry warnings.

benefit: Fabric GEM helps diagnose an infant in five days by flagging a variant
AI system or service: Fabric GEM artificial-intelligence variant interpretation tool with Phevor phenotype-driven re-ranking
deployed by: Rady Children's Institute for Genomic Medicine and Robert Wood Johnson University Hospital
measured against: chromosomal microarray and targeted gene panels
without the AI: one to two weeks for much more limited results from chromosomal microarray and four to six weeks for targeted gene panels
costs and harms: The authors list no cost or harm from the use of Fabric GEM. The authors report that the result helped the infant move to palliative care because of the poor prognosis.

benefit: An Emirati health agency adds a chatbot to its website
AI system or service: EHS.gov.ae and Ask EHS
deployed by: Emirates Health Services
measured against: not in the sources
costs and harms: The agency notes that the AI infrastructure is costly to set up and that the platform depends on internet access, so it built a lightweight version for slow connections. The agency has not reported that Ask EHS gave such answers.

benefit: Rescue workers in Türkiye find damaged areas with xView2 maps
vendor: US Defense Innovation Unit (DIU) with Carnegie Mellon University Software Engineering Institute; research partners Microsoft AI for Good and UC Berkeley
AI system or service: xView2 building damage assessment models (semantic segmentation on satellite imagery, trained on the xBD dataset)

measured against: conventional damage assessment
costs and harms: The imagery available varied by city. The authors of the technical report used images dated 7 to 9 February 2023. They warned that outdated building footprints or rubble outside a footprint could cause damage to be missed.

benefit: Vara MG helps German screening radiologists find more breast cancers
AI system or service: Vara MG
deployed by: Radiologists at 12 screening units of the German mammography screening program
measured against: Standard double reading without AI in the same program
costs and harms: The authors say that more detection of ductal carcinoma in situ raises concerns about overdiagnosis and overtreatment. That detection rate was 1.4 per 1,000 women with AI against 0.8 without. The positive predictive value of recall was 17.9% with AI, so most recalled women did not have cancer.

benefit: Türkiye quake: Mappers using AI-assisted RapiD were up to 12.4% slower

benefit: Camera AI on Spin e-scooters cuts time ridden on sidewalks 22%
AI system or service: Camera-based computer-vision riding-surface detection with in-app notifications, audible beeps and speed reduction on Spin shared e-scooters (maker not named in the paper)

benefit: Dosing by PMD-200 lowered pain scores after abdominal surgery

benefit: Supreme Court of India publishes hearing transcripts from TERES AI

benefit: AutoEF met its goal for accuracy in measuring how well the heart pumps

benefit: BVAS face matching accredited Nigerian voters when fingerprints failed

The Commonwealth group asked whether the facial software gave false positives.

benefit: Mia flags a 6 mm breast cancer that NHS Grampian radiologists missed

benefit: CCAA.91360 cut the time to read cervical cytology slides

benefit: Chilean prosecutors credit Fiscal Heredia with finding a robbery gang

with the AI: el sistema realiza un filtro y propone un número acotado de ellos

benefit: Italian researchers test forecasts of grid failures during heatwaves
vendor: ENEA with Politecnico di Bari and Università Roma Tre

deployed by: not in the sources

costs and harms: not in the sources

benefit: MY-CJ-01 raised detection of polyps on a first pass in Tencent's trial

with the AI: Polyp miss rate 23.39% (95%CI:18.92%~28.54%) in group B

benefit: Kent reports fewer homeless households after targeted support
AI system or service: Xantura AI-enabled predictive-analytics platform used for homelessness prevention
deployed by: Maidstone Borough Council and Kent County Council with participating district and borough councils
measured against: The council's earlier prevention effectiveness, implied by the reported 65% increase. The government states neither the baseline nor the method for counting avoided cases.
with the AI: increased prevention effectiveness by 65%, avoided 96 homelessness cases, and avoided 44 temporary accommodation placements
costs and harms: Editor's note: The reported comparison arose because some households could not receive support. Better prediction without additional response capacity can increase identified need without preventing additional homelessness.

benefit: Europe's medicines regulator accepts AIM-NASH for biopsy scoring
AI system or service: AIM-NASH (Artificial Intelligence-Based Measurement of NASH histology; also called AIM-MASH)
deployed by: PathAI with sponsors of MASH drug trials (validation on archived biopsies from trials of obeticholic acid, pegbelfermin and semaglutide)
