without the AI: Mean weighted kappa of unassisted reads
with the AI: Weighted kappa higher by 0.15 for ballooning and 0.12 for lobular inflammation
costs and harms: EMA noted that AIM-NASH did worse at identifying fibrosis stage 1 and at excluding stage 3, possibly by chance. For fibrosis, AI-assisted reads agreed less with the expert panel than the median manual read (0.65 against 0.72). EMA raised a concern that trials might score most slides with AIM-NASH but rejected slides with two human pathologists.

benefit: Police reached ShotSpotter alerts faster than 911 shot reports
vendor: ShotSpotter, Inc. (renamed SoundThinking, Inc. on 10 April 2023)

deployed by: New York City Police Department (NYPD)
measured against: NYPD response to 911 calls about outdoor gunfire in June 2023
costs and harms: In June 2023, 771 of 940 alerts could not be confirmed as shootings and 47 were unfounded. Officers spent 426.9 hours on them. In 2022 ShotSpotter missed its 90% target in Manhattan in 8 of 12 months. NYPD paid ShotSpotter $45.4 million from August 2014 to June 2023.

benefit: AI predicts new archaeological zones at Dubai's Saruq Al-Hadid site
vendor: Dubai Culture & Arts Authority and Khalifa University
AI system or service: Saruq Al-Hadid AI remote-sensing framework
deployed by: Dubai Culture & Arts Authority
measured against: not in the sources
costs and harms: Artnet News relayed a caution from Hugh Thomas, an archaeology lecturer at the University of Sydney, against over-reliance on AI to find sites. He said that nothing is better than a trained archaeological eye.

benefit: KidneyIntelX.dkd sorted diabetic patients by risk to their kidneys
AI system or service: KidneyIntelX.dkd
deployed by: Renalytix (retrospective validation on biobanked samples from 657 adults)
measured against: not in the sources
costs and harms: FDA lists false negative and false positive results and misinterpretation by clinicians as risks. In the validation, 17 of 374 adults placed at the low level (4.6%) still had a 40% decline in kidney function. High selenium levels may falsely raise results.

benefit: EU guideline group backs AI-supported double reading of mammograms
vendor: Three vendors that asked to remain anonymous in the study behind the estimate, with ScreenPoint Medical (Transpara), Lunit (INSIGHT MMG), Kheiron Medical Technologies (Mia) and DeepHealth in the other studies reviewed

deployed by: Screening services in the studies that the ECIBC guideline group reviewed, with Karolinska University Hospital's archived examinations behind the estimate and organized screening programs in the EU as intended users
measured against: Double reading without AI support, pooled from six studies that the guideline group reviewed
with the AI: one more breast cancer detected for every 1 000 women screened
costs and harms: The ECIBC group found that double reading with AI support may produce slightly more false positives than double reading alone. It warned that adding AI may increase costs and made adoption conditional on sustainability.

benefit: Distracted Driving and Seatbelt cameras pass a Victorian check
vendor: Jenoptik Australia, the contractor that manages the AI (named by the Victorian Auditor-General, while the Commissioner names no vendor)
AI system or service: Distracted Driving and Seatbelt road safety cameras with AI image recognition
deployed by: Department of Justice and Community Safety (Victoria), with Victoria Police
measured against: not in the sources
costs and harms: The Department of Justice and Community Safety kept some camera images longer than Victoria's regulations allow, including images used to check the AI's accuracy. Jenoptik archived images for 7 years until February 2026. Human review of detections is time and labor-intensive. Victoria Police bears the cost and risk of court proceedings when drivers contest infringements.

benefit: Lung screening centers may use AI nodule detection under NICE guidance
vendor: Siemens Healthineers, Coreline Soft, Riverain Technologies, contextflow, Infervision, Arterys, Qure.ai, SenseTime, MeVis, Aidence and VUNO
AI system or service: AI-derived computer-aided detection software for lung nodules: AI-Rad Companion Chest CT, AVIEW LCS+, ClearRead CT, contextflow SEARCH Lung CT, InferRead CT Lung, Lung AI, qCT-Lung, SenseCare-Lung Pro, Veolity, Veye Lung Nodules and VUNO Med-LungCT AI
deployed by: Screening centers in the studies reviewed by NICE and NHS targeted lung cancer screening centers in England during evidence generation
measured against: Clinician review of screening CT scans without the software
with the AI: More sensitive but less specific in nearly all studies
costs and harms: In screening studies, review with the AI nodule software was less specific, so more people would go on to CT surveillance. Outside targeted screening, NICE says it could cause unneeded surveillance and anxiety, and the model found it slightly less effective. The model priced it at £2 per scan in targeted screening.

benefit: EASYASPECT brought doctors' scores of stroke CT closer to experts'
vendor: Yukun (Beijing) Network Technology Co., Ltd. (语坤（北京）网络科技有限公司)
AI system or service: EASYASPECT (缺血性卒中CT图像辅助评估软件)
deployed by: Yukun (Beijing) Network Technology (retrospective reader trial at the Second Affiliated Hospital of Nanchang University and Hwa Mei Hospital of the University of Chinese Academy of Sciences in Ningbo)
measured against: The same eight doctors scoring the same cases without the software, with an expert panel as the reference
without the AI: Kappa 0.55 between doctors without the software and the expert panel
with the AI: Kappa 0.80 between doctors with the software and the expert panel (lower 95% confidence bound 0.79)
costs and harms: CMDE lists two risks: a false-positive result that leads to an unnecessary early examination, and a false-negative result that may delay a patient's diagnosis and treatment. No center reported a device defect in the trial.

benefit: AI from Princeton steers fusion plasmas clear of tearing instability
vendor: Princeton University / Princeton Plasma Physics Laboratory (Kolemen group), with Chung-Ang University
AI system or service: Deep reinforcement learning tearing-avoidance controller with a DNN tearability predictor (Keras model converted to real-time C)
deployed by: DIII-D National Fusion Facility, General Atomics
measured against: DIII-D discharges in the same experiment session without RL control
without the AI: all shots except one (193266: low-βN reference shown in Fig. 3b) were disrupted
costs and harms: The Princeton team has not reported costs or harms. The controller kept the estimated tearability under a threshold while it maintained high-confinement performance, and average time-integrated normalized beta rose.

benefit: ChatGPT speeds up everyday professional writing
AI system or service: ChatGPT
deployed by: MIT researchers (Noy and Zhang), in an online experiment
measured against: Participants without ChatGPT access
without the AI: Control group time and graded quality
costs and harms: Participants who used ChatGPT grew more worried about AI replacing workers in their occupation, by 0.26 standard deviations. The authors find that ChatGPT mostly substituted for worker effort. They warn that this could cut demand for workers, with capital owners gaining at workers' expense.

benefit: AI yield estimates speed crop insurance claims for some Indian farmers
vendor: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare (YES-TECH manual); Madhya Pradesh implementation by the Madhya Pradesh Council of Science and Technology as Technology Implementation Partner, mentored by NRSC Hyderabad (per CSE)
AI system or service: YES-TECH (Yield Estimation System based on Technology): satellite remote sensing, weather data and analytical models, including an 'AI/ML model' for kharif crops and a 'semi-physical model' for rabi crops in Madhya Pradesh
deployed by: Government of Madhya Pradesh under PMFBY with insurers (AIC, SBI General Insurance, HDFC Ergo); nine states in all as of January 2025
measured against: claims paid under manual crop-cutting experiments (2018)
costs and harms: Faster settlement could come with lower payments and reduced farmer confidence when model estimates differed from familiar crop-cutting results.

benefit: Bradford gallery shows a painting that software matched to a Raphael
vendor: University of Bradford and University of Nottingham team (Ugail); Art Recognition AG (Carina Popovici)
AI system or service: University of Bradford facial-recognition deep-learning comparison (Hassan Ugail); contrasted with Art Recognition's authentication model
deployed by: de Brecy Trust; Bradford Museums & Galleries (Cartwright Hall Art Gallery)
measured against: the painting's standing before the analysis
without the AI: thought by some experts to have been a Victorian copy
with the AI: found by the Bradford and Nottingham teams to be highly likely by Raphael, with 97% similarity between the two Madonnas
costs and harms: Editor's note: The measured quantity was facial similarity, while scholars identified the work as a possible later copy and another model rejected attribution.

benefit: AlphaFold-Multimer predicts a sperm protein needed for male fertility
AI system or service: AlphaFold-Multimer complex-prediction screen
deployed by: Research Institute of Molecular Pathology (Pauli lab) and collaborators
measured against: Prior knowledge of vertebrate fertilization and earlier biochemical searches for a sperm complex
without the AI: Tmem81 had no known role in fertilization, and biochemical attempts to find an IZUMO1–SPACA6 complex had limited success
with the AI: Tmem81 identified as part of a sperm complex with Izumo1 and Spaca6 and shown to be essential for male fertility in zebrafish and mice
costs and harms: No cost or harm has been reported, and no comparable incident is linked to this record.

benefit: A brain implant restores arm movement to a paralyzed man
vendor: Feinstein Institutes for Medical Research, Northwell Health (Institute of Bioelectronic Medicine, Chad Bouton)
AI system or service: Double neural bypass (Bidirectional Neural Bypass System): intracortical brain-computer interface with an LSTM decoder and deep reinforcement-learning agent, patterned spinal cord stimulation and intracortical microstimulation
deployed by: Northwell Health, North Shore University Hospital
measured against: Grasp-force control with the reinforcement-learning agent switched off, in the same participant
without the AI: 27% successful force control without the reinforcement-learning agent
with the AI: 87% successful force control with the reinforcement-learning agent
costs and harms: Editor's note: The original paper separates the 87% versus 27% grasp-task result from strength gains achieved before the hand neuroprosthesis. Combining them would exaggerate the evidence for one AI component.

benefit: Brain implant lets a paralyzed man converse at home for nearly two years
vendor: UC Davis Neuroprosthetics Lab (Brandman, Stavisky) with the BrainGate consortium
AI system or service: UC Davis intracortical speech neuroprosthesis (BrainGate2 trial)
deployed by: UC Davis Health
measured against: the participant's usual means of communication: speaking to expert listeners or typing with a head mouse
without the AI: about 6.8 correct words per minute with expert listeners and 6.3 correct words per minute with a gyroscopic head mouse
with the AI: a self-paced 31.6 words per minute with a 2.5% word error rate in the final five Copy Task evaluation sessions
costs and harms: Editor's note: High accuracy appeared within the first two days, while the retained conditions explicitly require signal stability and available recalibration.

benefit: Rising Academies' WhatsApp tutor Rori raises math scores in Ghana
AI system or service: Rori, AI-powered conversational math tutor on WhatsApp
deployed by: Rising Academies (11 schools)
measured against: control-group students at schools without Rori access who continued regular math instruction
without the AI: control group growth score M = 2.12 (SD = 6.30) between baseline and endline
with the AI: treatment group growth score M = 5.13 (SD = 7.03), an effect size of 0.36 (Cohen's d)
costs and harms: Editor's note: Controls continued regular instruction rather than receiving a matched non-AI tutoring session.

benefit: Waymo's driverless cars draw fewer insurance claims than human drivers
AI system or service: Waymo Driver (SAE Level 4 automated driving system) operating the Waymo One ride-hailing service
deployed by: Waymo LLC (Waymo One in Phoenix and San Francisco; later Los Angeles and Austin)
measured against: zip code-calibrated human-driver baseline built from Swiss Re liability claims
without the AI: 1.11 claims per million miles (bodily injury); 3.26 claims per million miles (property damage)
with the AI: 0.00 claims per million miles (bodily injury); 0.78 claims per million miles (property damage)
costs and harms: The safety advantage may depend partly on the service's selected roads, because residential zip codes do not fully match driving exposure. The independent study found a 4% higher crash rate in Austin on a small sample. A linked incident reports that a Waymo vehicle struck a child near an elementary school in Santa Monica, California.

benefit: Millions of students get real-time study help from the QANDA app
AI system or service: QANDA
deployed by: Mathpresso
measured against: not in the sources
costs and harms: Editor's note: The deployed function is question answering with feedback. Availability of a correct response is different from practice that changes a student’s own ability, and attainment has not been measured.

benefit: GPT-4 speeds up legal drafting for law students
AI system or service: GPT-4
deployed by: University of Minnesota Law School researchers (Choi, Monahan and Schwarcz)
measured against: Students completing the same task without GPT-4
without the AI: 69.72 minutes on average for the contract drafting task
with the AI: 47.59 minutes on average with GPT-4 (32.1% less)
costs and harms: Students first spent about two hours on training videos and exercises. On the fourth task, the client memo, average grades with GPT-4 were 0.07 points lower on a 4.0 scale. The authors note that GPT-4 sometimes invents sources and misreads them.

benefit: Viz HCM picked out a hard-to-diagnose heart disease from ECGs
AI system or service: Viz HCM
deployed by: Viz.ai (retrospective study on ECGs from three Massachusetts hospitals)
measured against: not in the sources
costs and harms: FDA names false negatives as the primary risk, and the software missed about three in ten patients with the disease. Because the disease is uncommon, the positive predictive value is only 13.7%, so most flags would be false positives. FDA judges that risk acceptable.

benefit: Facial recognition helps agents identify 311 probable child victims
vendor: Clearview AI (reported by ABC, Forbes and Crikey; not confirmed by Homeland Security Investigations) and unnamed image-enhancement tools

deployed by: Homeland Security Investigations (U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement), Cyber Crimes Center
measured against: the same abuse-material series as previously reviewed, which had left the cases cold
costs and harms: The likely contribution was narrowing a difficult search. Mistaken facial matches remained a reason to verify identities before investigators contacted families or suspects. Crikey reports that Australian case material was analyzed with Clearview AI, which the Australian Federal Police was not allowed to use.

benefit: Crews keep a fire small after ALERTCalifornia AI flags night smoke
vendor: ALERTCalifornia, University of California San Diego, with industry partner Digital Path

deployed by: California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection (CAL FIRE)
measured against: 911 calls from the public as the first notice of a fire
with the AI: the AI beats 911 calls about 40 percent of the time
costs and harms: AFP reports that dust, insects or weather sometimes register as smoke, so operators verify each detection before dispatch. A RAND researcher told the Associated Press that false alarms can cost time and attention.

benefit: STF's VitorIA finds at least 247 similar appeals for Tema 1.261

AI system or service: VitorIA (STF), textual-similarity clustering tool that groups appeals raising similar legal questions; in development in 2022 and operational in 2023 per the STF
deployed by: Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF)
measured against: not in the sources
costs and harms: The court reports no assessment of costs or harms here and does not say what happened to the 247 grouped appeals after the Plenary found no general repercussion.

benefit: A surgical robot helps a surgeon remove a brain clot from an awake man
AI system or service: Modus V Synaptive robotic digital microscope with Neuro-Navigation AI (image fusion, fiber-tract display, surgical simulation, trajectory warnings)
deployed by: Tam Anh General Hospital, Ho Chi Minh City
measured against: conventional (traditional) brain surgery under general anesthesia
without the AI: nếu mổ theo phương pháp truyền thống, nguy cơ di chứng cao (high risk of sequelae with the traditional method)
with the AI: khi được mổ lấy máu tụ tỉnh thức bằng robot AI, ông có thể song ca cùng bác sĩ ngay khi đang mổ (awake robot-assisted clot removal while talking and singing)
costs and harms: Editor's note: The team combined the rehearsed trajectory with an awake patient who talked and moved on request. Both anatomical planning and direct functional feedback were used during removal.

benefit: ALERTCalifornia AI may have helped contain the Trotter Fire
vendor: ALERTCalifornia, University of California San Diego (camera network); AI detection software supplier not named in the sources
AI system or service: ALERTCalifornia camera network with AI smoke detection (the Microsoft feature does not name the detection software)
deployed by: Kern County Fire Department (incident agency); which agency received the AI alert is not stated
measured against: the fire's estimated spread without AI-powered imaging, as estimated by ALERTCalifornia founder Neal Driscoll
costs and harms: Editor's note: The larger acreage is the network founder’s estimate, with no alert chronology or modeled spread analysis in the retained records.

benefit: GraphCast may have forecast Hurricane Lee's landfall nine days ahead
AI system or service: GraphCast (Google DeepMind graph neural network weather model), experimental live run on ECMWF public charts
deployed by: ECMWF (experimental data-driven forecasts on its public charts pages)
measured against: traditional physics-based forecasts of Hurricane Lee's landfall (DeepMind's own account)
without the AI: only locked in on Nova Scotia about six days in advance
costs and harms: MIT Technology Review reports that GraphCast still lags behind conventional models in some areas, such as precipitation. In the CIRA verification of the 2023 season, the intensity errors of four AI models, GraphCast among them, exceeded those of the simplest statistical forecasts. The models almost always reduced storm intensity, which produced a substantial low bias.

benefit: Border model flags a car at San Ysidro with 75 kg of narcotics inside
AI system or service: U.S. Customs and Border Protection (Office of Field Operations) machine-learning model that scores vehicle border-crossing histories for suspicious patterns; not named in any source
deployed by: U.S. Customs and Border Protection, Office of Field Operations (U.S. Department of Homeland Security)
measured against: Primary inspection without the model's alert
without the AI: An officer would have had no cause to give the car more than a normal stop.
with the AI: The alert led the officer to refer the car to secondary inspection, where officers found over 75 kilograms of narcotics.
costs and harms: Editor's note: The documented output was a referral, and no false-positive rate or inspection denominator is reported. Operational value therefore depends on selection yield as well as this seizure.

benefit: DrBrain-AD flagged hippocampal changes on brain MRI in China's review
vendor: Shenzhen Yiwei Medical Technology Co., Ltd. (深圳市铱硙医疗科技有限公司)
AI system or service: DrBrain-AD (磁共振图像辅助评估软件)

costs and harms: CMDE names two risks. A positive assessment may lead to unnecessary early examinations. A false negative assessment may delay diagnosis and treatment. benefit: Human-checked AI subtitles bring Nelonen up to Traficom's standard
vendor: Not named by Traficom (Media Tailor says that it built Nelonen Media's AI subtitling platform with Amberscript)

measured against: Nelonen's earlier subtitles, made mostly by the AI-based system without systematic human correction
without the AI: Failed the requirement of sufficient clarity and ease of understanding (decision of 3 April 2023)
costs and harms: For several years viewers and disability groups told Traficom that Nelonen's subtitles were often poor and made programs nearly impossible to follow. In autumn 2022 samples, Sanoma's AI still misheard proper names, foreign and slang words and could not tell speakers or sentences apart. Meeting the standard required human checking and correction of the AI subtitles.

benefit: AI100 with Shonit matched manual microscopy on 882 blood smears
AI system or service: AI100 with Shonit
deployed by: SigTuple (method comparison against manual microscopy at four sites)
measured against: Manual microscopy of the same 882 smears
with the AI: Sensitivity 92.7% and specificity 95.4% for abnormal white-cell results
costs and harms: Against manual microscopy, the device missed 7.3% of abnormal white-cell findings and flagged 4.6% of normal ones as abnormal. Specificity for poikilocytosis was 88.1%.

benefit: Consultants with GPT-4 finish more tasks in less time
AI system or service: GPT-4 (via a ChatGPT-style interface with default system prompt and temperature)
deployed by: Boston Consulting Group, with the Harvard Business School Digital Data Design Institute research team
measured against: Consultants randomly assigned to work without AI
without the AI: Control group task completion, speed and quality
with the AI: 12.2% more tasks, 25.1% faster, quality rated more than 40% higher
costs and harms: On a task chosen to lie outside the model's reach, consultants using GPT-4 were 19 percentage points less likely to produce correct solutions than those without AI. The ideas that consultants produced with AI were less variable and at risk of being more redundant.

benefit: Be My AI reads airport gate numbers for a blind user
vendor: Be My Eyes (feature built on OpenAI's GPT-4)
AI system or service: Be My AI (large-multimodal-model image description in the Be My Eyes app)
deployed by: Be My Eyes (consumer app used by study participants)
measured against: asking a sighted family member or friend to check a photo
without the AI: Before GenAI, I would often send it to my mom or friend to check for me.
costs and harms: Users carry the risk of acting on descriptions that they cannot check. P9 said of reading a check with Be My AI that “it could've exposed bank info”. Brigham and Kohno report complaints of inaccurate descriptions and paternalistic guardrails in reviews with few stars, and they name hallucinations as a problem with Be My AI.

benefit: Brain implant lets a man with ALS spell for 90 days without retraining
vendor: Johns Hopkins University (Crone lab and co-authors)
AI system or service: Click-based electrocorticographic brain-computer interface with an LSTM click detector (NCT03567213)
deployed by: Johns Hopkins University (laboratory sessions)
measured against: the Utrecht fully implanted switch-scan BCI reported by Vansteensel et al. (four contacts over hand motor cortex)
without the AI: a spelling rate of 1.8 letters per minute with a latency of at least 1 s per click
with the AI: a spelling rate of 10.2 CCPM and 0.68 s latency
costs and harms: The system required a chronically implanted electrode array. Each session began with a calibration recorded at rest. A transient reduction in signal power interrupted use of the fixed model, and home reliability was not tested.

benefit: NICE finds AI outlining quicker for radiotherapy planning
vendor: Siemens Healthineers, TheraPanacea, Mirada Medical, Carina Medical, Limbus AI, MIM Software, Philips, MVision AI and RaySearch
AI system or service: AI autocontouring software: AI-Rad Companion Organs RT, ART-Plan, DLCExpert, INTContour, Limbus Contour, MIM Contour ProtégéAI, MRCAT Prostate plus Auto-contouring, MVision Segmentation Service and RayStation
deployed by: Radiotherapy centers in the studies reviewed by NICE; NHS radiotherapy services in England
measured against: Manual contouring by radiotherapy staff
with the AI: 3 to 80 minutes saved in studies; experts estimated 10 to 30 minutes
costs and harms: The systems cost £4 to £50 per treatment plan. Small structures such as the optic nerve and pituitary gland sometimes needed major edits or were unusable. NICE warned of possible skill loss and algorithmic bias. In the 2026 NHS evaluation, 3.5% of AI contour sets needed major edits, and contour review took longer in the AI pathway.

benefit: Smartwatch app helps a remote doctor identify atrial fibrillation at sea
vendor: Not stated (the report does not name the device's maker)
AI system or service: Smartwatch ECG application; an automatic atrial-fibrillation flag is plausible, but the brand and classification method are not established.
deployed by: Centro Internazionale Radio Medico (CIRM), the Italian Telemedical Maritime Assistance Service, with the ship's captain
measured against: no electrocardiograph on board the ship
with the AI: Within seconds, the application confirmed the diagnostic hypothesis
costs and harms: not in the sources

benefit: Copilot saves Buckinghamshire staff time
AI system or service: Microsoft Copilot
deployed by: Buckinghamshire Council
measured against: Customer service agents writing call wrap-ups without Copilot
without the AI: About six minutes per call wrap-up, implied by a two-minute saving equal to 33%
with the AI: About four minutes per call wrap-up
costs and harms: The council reports hallucinations and inconsistent answers in other uses of Copilot, and it gives no costs of the rollout. The linked incident happened elsewhere, and the sources show no such harm in Buckinghamshire.

benefit: AI summaries of planning consultations save council officers time
AI system or service: Konveio and Go Vocal AI tagging and generative summarization tools
deployed by: West Oxfordshire District Council and Cotswold District Council
measured against: Officers summarizing and reporting consultation responses without the AI tools in the Cotswold consultation of February 2022
without the AI: Officer time needed to summarize and report on the February 2022 Cotswold consultation
with the AI: An average saving of up to 85 per cent of officer time on the West Oxfordshire consultation of August to October 2023
costs and harms: Editor's note: Grouping and compression favor recurring content unless officers also examine comments that do not fit the dominant tags.

benefit: EIDU learning app lifts pre-primary scores in a Kenyan trial
AI system or service: EIDU digital personalised learning (DPL) tool on low-cost Android devices
deployed by: EIDU with the Murang'a County government (291 pre-primary schools in the trial)
measured against: Control schools that had not yet received the EIDU model and kept teaching the non-digitized curriculum
costs and harms: County governments paid at least part of the cost of the Android devices. Learners share a device during the school day, and EdTech Hub notes the need to make device use equitable.

benefit: Observe's AI registers salmon activity rising with gill disease
AI system or service: Observe Technologies behavioral monitoring algorithm (patented convolutional neural network, EP3644717)
deployed by: Two commercial Atlantic salmon marine farms in Scotland, studied by the University of Stirling
measured against: the same cages in the two months before the activity rise
with the AI: mean activity 43.6% at Farm A in the two months after
costs and harms: Editor's note: Activity rose around known gill-health episodes and correlated with disease scores. That supports a candidate indicator, while the retained evidence reports no earlier alert or changed treatment.

benefit: Xinhua reports survival up 30% after students' AI flags sick geese
vendor: Sixteen students of the Shenzhen University-Tencent Cloud AI BEng program, guided by university teachers and Tencent engineers
AI system or service: AI goose-breeding program (recognition and tracking algorithms on farm cameras)
deployed by: Jin Shutao's lion-head goose farming cooperative, Houxi Village, Chenghai District, Shantou
measured against: the farm's survival rate before the AI program (no baseline figure is given)

costs and harms: Among 754 lesions that DERM marked for discharge and the consultant second read overturned, seven were cancers. At two trusts the cost-utility model showed higher cost and worse health effect. Thirteen percent of surveyed patients were uncomfortable with the AI. benefit: Wintics video analytics help SNCF spot people on the tracks
AI system or service: Algorithmic video processing developed by Wintics
deployed by: SNCF (rail security services), at stations in the Paris region
measured against: Video operators watching the camera feeds without the algorithm
costs and harms: SNCF logged 233 false intrusion alerts, and about two-thirds of its abandoned-object alerts were false. The committee notes that false alerts take up operators' time and erode their trust. A moved camera produces many false positives and negatives and needs tedious recalibration. The committee judged the interventions owed to the AI extremely few for the technical and financial means deployed.

benefit: Wintics alerts help RATP halve its time to intervene
AI system or service: Algorithmic video processing developed by Wintics
deployed by: RATP (security services on the Paris metro and RER)
measured against: RATP's intervention time from an alert before the experiment
costs and harms: RATP counted 324 false intrusion alerts against 1222 true ones. Over 78% of its abandoned-object alerts were false, 151 against 42 true. The Interior Ministry committed €357,441.17 for RATP's part in 2024 and €27,216.92 in 2025, sums that RATP is to repay in full.

benefit: Wintics alerts help Paris police watch a large Olympic site
AI system or service: Algorithmic video processing developed by Wintics, on tactical cameras
deployed by: Préfecture de police de Paris
measured against: not in the sources
costs and harms: In the Paralympic Games the prefecture logged 42 false positives among 401 crowd-density detections and 3 among 7 fire detections. Wintics's fallen-person detection confused people with objects of similar size, so the prefecture did not use it operationally. False alerts take up operators' time. The whole experiment cost about 0.9 million euros across all users.

benefit: Australian public servants perceive time saved with Copilot
AI system or service: Microsoft 365 Copilot
deployed by: Australian Government agencies in the whole-of-government trial coordinated by the Digital Transformation Agency
measured against: Doing the same tasks without Copilot, as participants estimated
with the AI: perceived time savings of around an hour a day for these tasks
costs and harms: Up to 7% of participants said that Copilot added time, since checking its output negated some savings. Its outputs may be biased towards western norms. Some participants felt pressured to consent to being recorded and transcribed. Agency interviews perceived a greater risk of job displacement for women and junior staff.

benefit: Most investigations from riskbaserade urval lead to action
vendor: Försäkringskassan (Swedish Social Insurance Agency), including a unit of its control function that develops selection profiles
AI system or service: Försäkringskassan's risk-based selections (riskbaserade urval) for control investigations: targeted checks (riktade kontroller) and selection profiles (urvalsprofiler)
deployed by: Försäkringskassan (Swedish Social Insurance Agency), control function
measured against: Control investigations started by tips from the public in 2024
costs and harms: About a quarter of investigations from the selections led to no action, meaning that no error was found or that an error was not acted on. Each selection profile takes about a year to build. In June 2025 Sweden's data protection authority opened a review of how the selections for temporary parental benefit process personal data.

benefit: Variance Reduction System keeps Meta's housing ads to agreed limits
AI system or service: Variance Reduction System (VRS)
deployed by: Meta Platforms, Inc. (housing ads on Facebook, Instagram and Messenger)
measured against: The VRS Compliance Metrics that the Department of Justice and Meta agreed and the court adopted
without the AI: Required coverage of 90.2% (sex, variance of 10% or less, ads with at least 300 impressions)
costs and harms: Meta's compliance calculation omitted some housing ads that also carried another special ad category. A sampling issue between 1 and 15 January 2024 left some audience samples below the expected minimum size. Meta says that privacy noise may slightly degrade the system's maximum performance in reducing variance.

benefit: Koios DS Breast helped readers classify breast lumps on ultrasound
AI system or service: Koios DS Breast
deployed by: Readers in the four retrospective studies that AQuAS reviewed, three in the United States and one in Spain

costs and harms: Distributors quoted a fixed 5,000 USD to install the server, then an annual subscription of 12,000 USD for one device or 12,000 to 126,000 euros by hospital size. In the largest study, the software misclassified 7 of 430 malignant lesions (1.6%) and 232 of 470 benign lesions (49.4%).

benefit: AI echocardiography assistants match experts' ejection fractions

costs and harms: Real-Time EF's sensitivity for systolic dysfunction was 73%, so it missed some patients. AETSA said that expert cardiologists should supervise the tools because their results should not replace a specialist's diagnosis.

benefit: Ethos daily replanning improves tumor coverage in Malaysia's review
vendor: Varian Medical Systems (a Siemens Healthineers company)

deployed by: Several radiotherapy centers in the 10 studies that MaHTAS reviewed, among them University Hospital Essen, UT Southwestern Medical Center, Rigshospitalet and Medisch Spectrum Twente
measured against: The scheduled (non-adaptive) plans for the same fractions, in one study of 11 prostate cancer patients in the Netherlands
without the AI: 86.7% ± 6.2% coverage of the PTV60Gy with the scheduled plan
costs and harms: Adaptation adds 13 to 34 minutes to each session. One U.S. study put the incremental cost at $103.58 per adaptive fraction. MaHTAS lists the need for a skilled multidisciplinary team with extra training and a risk of algorithm bias in AI-driven plan generation.

benefit: Austin's license plate readers led to 165 arrests in a 2024 trial
vendor: Flock Safety (fixed cameras and ALPR service) and Axon Enterprise (vehicle-mounted cameras)
AI system or service: Automated License Plate Reader (ALPR) program with Flock Safety fixed cameras and Axon vehicle-mounted cameras
deployed by: Austin Police Department (APD)
measured against: not in the sources
costs and harms: The City's contract with Flock Safety may let the company keep some scan data past the seven-day limit and share it with other law enforcement agencies. The auditor warned that such data could be used to investigate immigration status or reproductive care access. Some officer searches lacked the reason that policy requires.

benefit: Ulangizi advice on potatoes earns a Malawi farmer more than $800
AI system or service: Ulangizi (generative AI farming chatbot on WhatsApp)
deployed by: Opportunity International farmer support agents in Mulanje, with backing from the Government of Malawi
measured against: not in the sources
costs and harms: Farmer support agents lose much of their hour-long village meetings waiting for responses to load on poor connectivity, and sometimes climb hills for a signal. A Malawian technology specialist warned that inaccurate advice, such as a misidentified crop disease, could ruin a crop and a struggling farmer's livelihood. Reaching enough communities remains a challenge.

benefit: ShotSpotter got police to gunfire sooner, but crime did not fall
AI system or service: ShotSpotter gunshot detection technology (GDT), with alerts confirmed at the Real-Time Incident Review Center
deployed by: Kansas City Police Department and Chicago Police Department
measured against: Citizen calls for service about shots fired in Kansas City
without the AI: 390.87 s to arrive on scene, stopping 54.62 m from the gunfire
with the AI: 266.82 s to arrive on scene, stopping 35.66 m from the gunfire
costs and harms: ShotSpotter costs Kansas City between $227,500 and $315,000 a year and cost Chicago between $8.8M and $12.3M a year. In Kansas City, shots-fired calls in the covered area were 18% more likely to be classified as unfounded. In Chicago, covered areas saw on average 15.6 more fatal shootings than their controls over the intervention period.

benefit: Latin NCAP gives Ranger's Pre-Collision Assist full pedestrian marks
AI system or service: Pre-Collision Assist automatic emergency braking, as fitted to the Ford Ranger (2024)
deployed by: Ford (factory-fitted on the Ranger built in Argentina for Latin America)
measured against: not in the sources
costs and harms: not in the sources

benefit: Beeline AI People Search finds more people than volunteer reviewers
AI system or service: Beeline AI - Поиск людей (Beeline AI People Search), a neural network that finds people in drone photographs
deployed by: LizaAlert volunteer search-and-rescue squad
measured against: The squad's image-review group of more than 200 volunteers

with the AI: In 2024 the neural network found more people than the image-review group
costs and harms: not in the sources

benefit: Nagish captions calls faster than other providers in the FCC's tests
vendor: Nagish, Inc., on speech recognition and text-to-speech from unnamed vendors

costs and harms: Nagish's captions had errors. In the National Test Lab's three call scenarios its word error rate ranged from 2.1% to 9.6%, and its upper figure was above the 7.4% upper average of other caption providers.

benefit: Global Caption's captions for people in custody arrive faster in tests
vendor: Global Caption, Inc., with a speech recognition vendor that the FCC does not name
AI system or service: Global Caption ASR-only Internet Protocol Captioned Telephone Service (IP CTS) for carceral facilities

measured against: Other IP CTS providers' average caption delay on the same two call scenarios
costs and harms: In the lab tests Global Caption's word error rate ran from 4.1% to 11.9%, higher than the 2.0% to 7.4% of other providers.

benefit: SpliceAI flags a hidden genetic cause of a baby's fatal kidney disease
vendor: SpliceAI authors (Jaganathan et al., Cell 2019), as cited in the case report; the developing organization is not named in the source text
AI system or service: SpliceAI
deployed by: NICUnet consortium / Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai (Rareservoir variant database)
measured against: Standard analysis of coding variants in PKHD1 after trio whole-genome sequencing
without the AI: Only the paternal pathogenic missense variant was found; no maternally inherited coding variant explained the disease.
with the AI: SpliceAI nominated a maternal deep intronic variant with a score of 0.98, which RNA studies confirmed as the second allele.
costs and harms: Editor's note: Only one of 78,575 rare intronic PKHD1 variants scored higher. The team still confirmed an abnormal exon and premature stop experimentally before clinical use.

benefit: BrainSee predicted which patients with memory loss would get dementia
AI system or service: BrainSee
deployed by: Darmiyan (retrospective validation on 198 patients from 27 North American sites)
measured against: Pre-defined goals of sensitivity and specificity above 70%
with the AI: Specificity 96%, sensitivity 73% with a lower bound of 65%
costs and harms: BrainSee missed 32 of 118 patients who progressed, a sensitivity of 73%. FDA lists false positives that lead to inappropriate treatment and delayed diagnosis of other conditions, and false negatives that delay diagnosis or treatment, as risks to health, and required a postmarket study.

benefit: DermaSensor raised primary care sensitivity for skin cancer
AI system or service: DermaSensor
deployed by: Primary care sites in the DERM-SUCCESS study
measured against: The same primary care physicians judging the same lesion images without the device output
costs and harms: FDA names false negatives, which could delay a cancer diagnosis, and false positives, which can cause patient anxiety and more biopsies, as the main risks. Device specificity was 20.7%. Aided physicians' specificity fell from 44.2% to 32.4%. The maker prices the device at US$399 a month.

benefit: Fibresolve flagged more lung fibrosis than experts in FDA's review
AI system or service: Fibresolve
deployed by: Imvaria (retrospective study on 300 CT cases from the Lung Tissue Research Consortium)
measured against: An expert panel of five pulmonologists and thoracic radiologists reviewing the same cases
costs and harms: Fibresolve finds people who have IPF at the expense of a high rate of false positives, with a specificity lower bound of 73%. FDA notes that a false positive could lead to inappropriate IPF treatment or to forgoing curative treatment for another fibrotic lung disease.

benefit: Man regains movement in a paralyzed replanted arm
vendor: Center for Bionics and Pain Research / University of Gothenburg (academic clinical team); device by Integrum AB
AI system or service: Myoelectric motor execution with sensory training: Neuromotus 8-channel EMG and LDA classifier driving virtual limbs and serious games
deployed by: Center for Bionics and Pain Research and Sahlgrenska University Hospital (C.A.R.E.), Mölndal; treatment site not named in the paper
measured against: the arm's function before treatment, after conventional rehabilitation
without the AI: no active movement prior the MME interventions
with the AI: active extension of the thumb (4 degrees) and regained active wrist movement (flex: 6 degrees, extend: 10 degrees)
costs and harms: The patient gained some movement but could not fully open or close the replanted hand, and pain did not improve meaningfully.

benefit: CAD4TB falls just short of WHO's target for TB screening in Africa
AI system or service: CAD4TB, with qXR in one study (computer-aided detection software for TB)
deployed by: Active case-finding programs and national TB prevalence surveys in Kenya, South Africa and Zambia (five studies)
measured against: WHO's target product profile for a TB screening test
with the AI: pooled sensitivity of 0.87 and specificity of 0.74
costs and harms: At 1% prevalence, the software would miss 1 of every 10 people with TB and send 257 of every 990 without TB for testing. Specificity fell sharply in people with past TB, to 0.24 for CAD4TB v7 against 0.60 in others. A more sensitive threshold raises the cost of confirmatory tests.

benefit: Rogervoice's automatic captions arrive faster in the FCC's lab tests
vendor: Rogervoice SAS (the FCC does not name the speech recognition engine)

deployed by: Rogervoice SAS

costs and harms: Rogervoice's median word error rates of 2.7% to 11.7% were higher than the 2.0% to 7.4% of other providers. A coalition of accessibility groups, while not opposing the application, argued that providers of automatic-only service should offer a mode with human assistants and let users switch during a call.

benefit: SpeechPath captions come faster at similar accuracy in the FCC's tests

costs and harms: SpeechPath's captions had errors. In the National Test Lab's three call scenarios its median word error rate ranged from 0.8% to 7.6%, and its upper figure was above the 7.4% upper figure of other caption providers.

benefit: Faster stroke treatment followed e-Stroke, RapidAI and Viz
AI system or service: e-Stroke, RapidAI and Viz (AI-derived software for CT brain scans in suspected stroke)

measured against: Time to treatment before centers adopted the software, in seven observational studies
with the AI: Shorter time to thrombectomy or thrombolysis in most of the studies
costs and harms: In one study the stroke software failed to analyze 20 of 176 CT perfusion scans (11%). Experts said that reviewing false positive results adds to clinicians' work. Clinical experts warned that the software could worsen outcomes for people whose diagnosis was missed because of its influence on clinical decisions.

benefit: Pindrop traces a fake Biden robocall in New Hampshire to ElevenLabs
AI system or service: Pindrop deepfake audio analysis (voice-engine attribution)
deployed by: Pindrop (developer and deployer are the same company); independent corroboration by Hany Farid's UC Berkeley model
measured against: not in the sources
costs and harms: Editor's note: The models analyzed audio signatures, while the later criminal investigation concerned a human operator and is not linked to this analysis in the sources.

benefit: NEO brain implant lets a man quadriplegic for 14 years drink unaided
vendor: Tsinghua University School of Medicine, Prof. Hong Bo's team, with Neuracle Medical Technology (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. (博睿康科技), the trial sponsor
AI system or service: NEO (Neural Electronic Opportunity) wireless minimally invasive epidural brain-computer interface: eight epidural electrodes over the sensorimotor cortex, a battery-free coin-sized skull implant powered and read through the scalp, and a Riemannian-geometry grasp-intention decoder driving a pneumatic exoskeleton glove
deployed by: Xuanwu Hospital, Capital Medical University, Beijing (teams of Zhao Guoguang and Shan Yongzhi)
measured against: his own state before implantation, quadriplegic for 14 years after complete cervical spinal cord injury (ASIA A)
without the AI: 处于四肢瘫痪状态已经14年 (no hand function for 14 years)
with the AI: 实现自主喝水等脑控功能，抓握解码准确率超过90% (brain-controlled drinking, grasp decoding accuracy above 90%)
costs and harms: The system restored a useful grasp through one limited command that he could repeat, and the movement that he kept in his forearm helped him position objects. He or a caregiver had to attach the external coil and the glove for each session.

benefit: Genius Cervical AI helped cytology teams catch more precancers
AI system or service: Genius Digital Diagnostics System with the Genius Cervical AI algorithm
deployed by: Four US cytology laboratories in Hologic's multi-center clinical study
measured against: The same cytology teams reading the glass slides by light microscope
costs and harms: With Genius Cervical AI, specificity fell significantly at four thresholds, by 1.3% to 2.9%. FDA says that false positives may lead to unnecessary colposcopy and biopsy, which can cause discomfort, and that false negatives may mean no further workup, which may increase illness and death.

benefit: Kingston reports shorter social-care documentation with AI
AI system or service: Beam Magic Notes
deployed by: Kingston Council

costs and harms: The Ada Lovelace Institute reports that the work of reviewing AI outputs keeps some social workers from saving time and that AI errors risk entering care records. A fluent but inaccurate summary could make the worker’s checking task harder.

benefit: Somerset staff report time saved on meeting notes in a Copilot pilot

deployed by: Somerset Council

benefit: AI drilling planner helps KoBold appraise a copper deposit in Zambia

costs and harms: KoBold and Mingomba Mining have published no assessment of costs or harms to stakeholders.

benefit: ShotSpotter sped Durham's police response to gunfire by 1.2 minutes
AI system or service: ShotSpotter gunfire-detection service

benefit: A nurse returns to full-time work after software detects her brain bleed

benefit: AI ink detection lets scholars read part of a sealed Herculaneum scroll

benefit: NICE lets NHS talking therapies use the Limbic Access chatbot

It lists confidentiality breaches as a potential risk.

benefit: Samsung's Sleep Apnea Feature caught most moderate to severe cases
AI system or service: Sleep Apnea Feature (Samsung Galaxy Watch and Phone)

measured against: Polysomnography scored by physicians and preset acceptance criteria

benefit: AI cameras alert train crews to elephants on a railway at Madukkarai
AI system or service: AI-based elephant early warning system (24 hybrid thermal cameras on 12 towers, Elephant Control and Command Center, Puthupathi)
deployed by: Tamil Nadu Forest Department (Department of Environment, Climate Change and Forests), with railway station masters at Walayar and Ettimadai and loco pilots

benefit: Experts prefer ChatGPT's advice on rice to extension agents' in Kano
AI system or service: ChatGPT

benefit: West Berkshire council uses GPT to help managers draft job adverts

measured against: Managers drafting job adverts by hand

with the AI: A substantial reduction in drafting time, reported by managers without a figure, and uniform formatting

benefit: Dr.Wise-AADS helped doctors find more brain aneurysms on CT

benefit: Pangu-Weather and FengWu narrowly beat physics models on 2023 storms

benefit: Pangu-Weather beats ECMWF on 2023 typhoon tracks in China's check
vendor: Huawei (Pangu-Weather), Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory (FengWu) and Fudan University (FuXi)
AI system or service: Pangu-Weather, FengWu and FuXi, run in real time at CMA's National Meteorological Centre

benefit: North Yorkshire reports faster retrieval of social-care data
vendor: North Yorkshire Council using Microsoft Azure AI
AI system or service: Microsoft Azure AI proof of concept for semantic search and automatically generated eco-maps in Liquidlogic LCS records

measured against: Retrieving the same information through the existing Liquidlogic case-management system
without the AI: Time and cost of selected data-retrieval tasks in the existing system (figures not published)
with the AI: 90 percent less time and cost for those tasks in the pilot
costs and harms: North Yorkshire Council has published no assessment of harms. The council reports that technical hurdles narrowed the initial user testing, and it lists data refresh among the possibilities for later phases.

benefit: Hertfordshire tests an AI robot that repairs road cracks

AI system or service: Robotiz3d ARRES Eye and ARRES Prevent road-maintenance robot
deployed by: Hertfordshire County Council
measured against: The same detection model before it was retrained on scans of Hertfordshire roads.
costs and harms: No harm from the pilot has been reported, and the net cost of the repairs is unmeasured.

benefit: SES Water's AI leak alarms cut leak run times by up to 40%
AI system or service: SES Water smart network using Aquasuite Burst predictive leak detection, with flow and pressure sensors
deployed by: Sutton and East Surrey (SES) Water
measured against: SES Water's earlier practice, in which an analyst checked pressure and flow data by eye once a day
without the AI: a daily manual check of pressure and flow deviations, with leak run times not quantified
with the AI: run time of critical burst mains cut by 40%
costs and harms: Editor's note: The reported result concerns leak run time, and the described workflow starts after abnormal flow or pressure occurs. Fast repair limits loss after a fault.

benefit: Researchers build a laboratory test of safer autonomous wheelchairs
vendor: SUPSI / IDSIA Trustworthy Autonomous Systems research group
AI system or service: REXASI-PRO autonomous-wheelchair safety system

measured against: Road-crossing decisions based on single sensors

with the AI: Decisions from several diverse sensors combined, with better decision accuracy in a laboratory test
costs and harms: The REXASI-PRO project cost 3,770,558.75 euros. Swissinfo reports that the wheelchair system's lack of transparency makes responsibility for an error or accident hard to attribute, and that no legislation regulates the flight of its drones in public and urban spaces.

benefit: Te Hiku Media's te reo Māori recognition may be 92% accurate

benefit: Wales supports CADe colonoscopy after it found more adenomas in trials

Removal of non-neoplastic polyps was higher with CADe, at 1.17 lesions per colonoscopy against 0.61, which HTW treats as possible overtreatment.

benefit: Tesla software may have driven a sick owner 13 miles to a hospital

costs and harms: A medical crisis can impair the supervision on which this driving system depends. NHTSA told Tesla that the company's repost of the story conflicted with the company's own message that drivers must stay in control.

benefit: Sepsis ImmunoScore sorted patients by sepsis risk in FDA's review

deployed by: Prenosis (retrospective validation on data from three US hospitals)
measured against: Pre-specified AUROC performance goal
costs and harms: FDA lists risks of algorithm failure that places a patient in a higher category and leads to unnecessary treatment or in a lower category and leads to delayed or ineffective treatment, of model bias, and of overreliance on the score. In the low risk group, 7 of 232 patients had sepsis.

benefit: Rho detects low bone density on routine x-rays but misses many cases
AI system or service: Rho
deployed by: 16 Bit (retrospective study on x-rays from True North Imaging, OneMedNet and the Osteoarthritis Initiative)
measured against: Pre-specified goals for specificity and AUC, with DXA as the reference
without the AI: Specificity goal of a lower 95% bound above 0.775
costs and harms: Rho's sensitivity was 0.36 to 0.67, so it missed a third or more of patients with low bone density. It fell below 30% for knee x-rays in both US datasets. FDA notes that false positives could lead to unnecessary imaging, including DXA, and false negatives to missed or delayed assessment.

benefit: Safety Talk translates for construction sites with over 90% accuracy
vendor: Crowdworks AI and anonymized Company S

deployed by: Company S (anonymized construction firm)
measured against: General translation apps such as Google Translate and Papago
without the AI: The general apps mistranslated construction terms, according to the developer.
with the AI: Safety Talk reached over 90% translation accuracy in field tests, according to the developer.
costs and harms: Editor's note: The intended setting is construction and shipbuilding, where one mistaken instruction can matter disproportionately. Aggregate translation accuracy does not establish performance for each language or high-risk instruction.

benefit: A stage I cancer is removed in Chiayi after AI colonoscopy flags a polyp

measured against: not in the sources
costs and harms: Editor's note: The account attributes marking to the system but does not establish that the clinician would otherwise have missed the 1–1.5 cm lesion.

benefit: Four AI models, GraphCast among them, capture Storm Ciarán's structure

AI system or service: FourCastNet, Pangu-Weather, GraphCast and FourCastNet-v2
deployed by: not in the sources

without the AI: Physics-based forecasts of the storm's deepening and track
with the AI: AI forecasts of deepening and track that matched them more than 48 hours ahead

None captured the sharp bent-back warm front, and only some resolved the warm core seclusion. The authors say that the models cannot discern mesoscale jets.

benefit: FDA qualified the AFib History Feature for trials of ablation devices

benefit: AI biopsy review catches more prostate cancers in HTW's pooled studies

costs and harms: HTW's model puts AI-assisted review at £207 more per patient than pathologist review alone, for 0.02 extra quality-adjusted life years. Experts told the panel that even a small cost per patient can be hard to fund nationally.

benefit: UNOSAT reports that analysts left 86% of Flood AI images uncorrected

deployed by: UNOSAT Emergency Mapping Service (UNITAR)
measured against: not in the sources

benefit: ColoSense stool RNA test found 25 of 27 colorectal cancers

deployed by: Geneoscopy (CRC-PREVENT study with participants from 48 US states)
measured against: The FIT component of ColoSense alone, in the same adults
costs and harms: ColoSense can give false negative and false positive results. A false negative misses a cancer or precancerous lesion that colonoscopy would find. A false positive sends a person without cancer or a precancerous lesion to a follow-up colonoscopy.

benefit: AI shortens semiconductor floor planning

deployed by: ASICLAND pilot partnership
measured against: manual floor planning by specialized engineers with conventional design tools

with the AI: PPA 0.864 and NPA 0.849 for home scans
costs and harms: FDA lists false positives, which may lead to unnecessary visits or procedures, and false negatives or missing outputs, which may delay monitoring or treatment. In the 001 Study, seven participants (3.9%) did not image themselves successfully. Ten were excluded from the analysis for poor image quality or problems with calibration or self-imaging.

benefit: Tutor CoPilot helps tutors raise students' mastery of math topics

without the AI: 62% student passing rate on exit tickets (control tutors)
with the AI: 66% passing rate (tutors with Tutor CoPilot), 4 percentage points higher
costs and harms: Editor's note: Observed behavior shifted toward asking students to explain and away from giving solutions, alongside larger gains for lower-rated tutors.

benefit: Two men are jailed after face recognition identifies a Northwich dealer
AI system or service: Cheshire Constabulary facial recognition system (retrospective)
deployed by: Cheshire Constabulary, Northwich Proactive Policing Unit
measured against: conventional identification of a suspect who was not known locally
without the AI: The 18-year-old was not known in the Northwich area
with the AI: we were quickly able to identify him as a suspect
costs and harms: Editor's note: The officer explicitly said that the 18-year-old was not known locally, and the convictions followed physical and phone evidence.

benefit: DentalMonitoring reads phone photos of braces for orthodontists

deployed by: Dental Monitoring (retrospective and prospective studies with US orthodontists)
measured against: not in the sources
costs and harms: FDA lists the risks of adverse tissue reaction, use error that conveys incorrect oral health information to the clinician, software malfunction that leads to inaccurate monitoring, failure to identify a condition that delays treatment, and poor image capture. FDA says that results are not for stand-alone clinical decisions.

It also notes that patients may not know what visual information a platform stores.

benefit: Europe's forecast center tests Pangu-Weather beside its own model

costs and harms: The authors identify overly smooth forecasts, bias that grows with lead time and poor prediction of tropical cyclone intensity as drawbacks of the machine-learning forecasts. Pangu-Weather clearly underestimates cyclone intensity and predicts fewer weak cyclones than the IFS.

benefit: Insilico's AI-designed drug improves lung function in a small trial

benefit: Smartwatch readings lead to a family's long QT diagnosis

benefit: DeepCxR would cut TB screening costs at some loss of accuracy
vendor: Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR), Department of Health Research (DHR) and Institute for Plasma Research (IPR), Department of Atomic Energy, Government of India
AI system or service: DeepCxR (AI-assisted chest X-ray interpretation for TB screening)
deployed by: India's National TB Elimination Program (NTEP), as the program that HTAIn modeled (no deployment described)
measured against: Radiologists' interpretation of digital chest X-rays, modeled for 1,000 adults with presumptive TB
without the AI: Sensitivity 87%, specificity 89%, cost 299,077 INR per 1,000 screened
with the AI: 85.9% Sensitivity and 62.6% Specificity, cost 247,747 INR per 1,000 screened
costs and harms: In the model, DeepCxR gave 318 false positives per 1,000 people screened against 94 for radiologists. It found 128.78 people with TB against 130.5 and made 227 fewer correct classifications. The assessors warn that the savings must be weighed against a substantial increase in misclassification and false positives.
